about: JoJo power sidecar (jojo-readers lane, 2026-11-18): Stand stat letters (Power, Speed, Range, Durability, Precision, Potential; A-E plus Infinite and Null) and shape tags per ledger row. Keyword tags and model readings are unchecked.

jojo.stand.20th_century_boy.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.20th_century_boy.trigger: Magent Magent activates the ability and kneels to the ground.
jojo.stand.20th_century_boy.limit: He must remain immobile while invulnerable and expose himself when activating it; the ability has no offensive capability.
jojo.stand.20th_century_boy.beaten_by: Sneak attacks while he is immobile, or trapping him by exploiting his inability to move or react quickly.
jojo.stand.20th_century_boy.summary: When Magent Magent activates 20th Century Boy and kneels, it redirects incoming energy and projectiles away from him, making him impervious to damage and other dangers such as drowning.

jojo.stand.achtung_baby.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.achtung_baby.trigger: Shizuka is invisible by default; great distress increases the effect to nearby things within a several-foot radius.
jojo.stand.achtung_baby.limit: Nearby effect has a limited radius. Invisible things can still be detected by sounds or odors.
jojo.stand.achtung_baby.beaten_by: Helping Shizuka recover her calm ends the invisibility on affected objects.
jojo.stand.achtung_baby.summary: Achtung Baby makes Shizuka invisible by default and, when she is greatly distressed, also makes nearby objects and people invisible. Those affected remain invisible after leaving its range until Shizuka calms down, when they become visible again.

jojo.stand.aerosmith.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.aerosmith.trigger: Narancia uses the radar to detect carbon dioxide from a source when it exhales; Aerosmith can fire its weapons or use its propeller to attack.
jojo.stand.aerosmith.limit: The radar cannot distinguish sources well in a big crowd or near a large fire. Aerosmith has poor precision and only one bomb.
jojo.stand.aerosmith.beaten_by: A big crowd or large fire can overwhelm the radar's ability to distinguish sources.
jojo.stand.aerosmith.summary: Aerosmith attacks with wing-mounted machine guns, a grenade-strength bomb, and its propeller, while its radar locates and estimates the size of carbon-dioxide sources by their emissions.

jojo.stand.all_along_watchtower.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked

novel_sheet.name: All Along the Watchtower
novel_sheet.source: Purple Smoke Distortion (Kadono), chapter-end Stand sheet

jojo.stand.all_along_watchtower.limit: Its cards rely on stealth and range for surveillance, and the Stand is weak in direct battle against most Stand users.
jojo.stand.all_along_watchtower.summary: All Along Watchtower’s 53 independent cards can secretly observe targets and relay information to Cannolo as a circus act; their thin forms also let them carry out assassinations. Damage to the Stand is distributed across the cards, so Cannolo receives only 1/53 of the damage inflicted on it.

jojo.stand.anubis.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.anubis.trigger: Someone must draw the sword, and Anubis must allow them to wield it; then it can take control of them.
jojo.stand.anubis.limit: It must possess a wielder to fight. Its remembered counters make repeated tactics ineffective, and its growth in strength and speed is described as uncertain.
jojo.stand.anubis.beaten_by: An indirect approach that leaves it no point of attack or vulnerability, such as an environmental effect.
jojo.stand.anubis.summary: Anubis can choose who is able to draw its sword, then take over the wielder’s body and control their Stand. It remembers attacks used against it and adapts, becoming stronger and faster as a fight continues.

jojo.stand.aqua_necklace.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.aqua_necklace.trigger: Anjuro must remain close to command Aqua Necklace; it can possess someone by entering through their mouth.
jojo.stand.aqua_necklace.limit: It cannot break through a rubber glove, and damage to it transfers to Anjuro.
jojo.stand.aqua_necklace.beaten_by: A rubber glove blocks it from breaking through; damaging Aqua Necklace also harms Anjuro.
jojo.stand.aqua_necklace.summary: Aqua Necklace can disguise itself as liquids or vapor, reform after conventional attacks, and enter a person through the mouth to control them or tear through their innards. Damage to the Stand also affects Anjuro, who must stay close to command it.

jojo.stand.atom_heart_father.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.atom_heart_father.trigger: The camera takes a photograph; Yoshihiro can act through the resulting image, and close-ups let him extend his head and arms out of it.
jojo.stand.atom_heart_father.limit: The power is bound to the camera. Destroying the camera interrupts events in existing photographs; destroying the photograph containing Yoshihiro makes his ghost disappear forever.
jojo.stand.atom_heart_father.beaten_by: Anyone can use the camera. Jotaro photographs Yoshihiro alone and destroys the camera, trapping him in the small photograph and preventing further use of his power.
jojo.stand.atom_heart_father.summary: Atom Heart Father works through a Polaroid camera: Yoshihiro can move and act within its photographs, and events there are reflected in the real world. The photo’s frame isolates those inside, while damage to the photo is transferred to its subjects.

jojo.stand.atum.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.atum.trigger: Soul theft requires the person to recognize defeat in a game and pledge their soul, though Atum can partially grip a soul if the person is taken by surprise.
jojo.stand.atum.limit: A surprised person’s soul may be gripped without being stolen. Stolen souls are held in dolls made by Telence; he can gamble and release them. Soul reading is described for nearby people, and Telence may forget about people he is examining.
jojo.stand.atum.summary: Atum can take a person's soul after they acknowledge defeat in a game and place it in a doll; it can also secretly ask nearby souls yes-or-no questions and read their answers through aura changes.

jojo.stand.awaking_iii_leaves.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.awaking_iii_leaves.trigger: Mitsuba spawns and places arrows; on a person, the arrows expel foreign objects in the direction of the larger arrow.
jojo.stand.awaking_iii_leaves.limit: The text gives no cost or range. Multiple arrows route energy by the shortest path through the space they surround.
jojo.stand.awaking_iii_leaves.summary: Awaking III Leaves places directional arrows that redirect energy and expel foreign objects along the arrows’ direction. Multiple arrows route energy along the shortest path through the space they surround, while arrows stacked on the same axis multiply a force.

jojo.stand.baby_face.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.baby_face.trigger: Creating a junior requires researching a suitable woman and developing the child; it appears after about three minutes. The junior’s matter manipulation works by touching a target.
jojo.stand.baby_face.limit: Creating and training a junior is laborious. The junior can disobey under duress, and it is vulnerable to ordinary hazards such as burning. Cubed lifeforms usually remain alive unless key body parts are removed.
jojo.stand.baby_face.summary: Baby Face creates an independent junior Stand that fights as Melone’s proxy. The junior can divide touched matter into cubes, then rearrange those cubes into other forms; it can also reshape itself to hide or evade attacks.

jojo.stand.bad_company.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.bad_company.trigger: Keicho deploys and commands the units; defensive fire can intercept a projectile if the units have time to see it coming.
jojo.stand.bad_company.limit: The units are individually weaker, and focusing all of them on offense leaves Keicho defenseless. In the live-action adaptation, each command locks the army into that task and cannot be changed.
jojo.stand.bad_company.beaten_by: Attacking Keicho while the army is focused on offense; a projectile they lack time to see coming.
jojo.stand.bad_company.summary: Bad Company deploys a colony of miniature soldiers and vehicles that Keicho commands to attack or defend with their weapons. Coordinated fire can overwhelm targets or intercept incoming projectiles, but committing the whole force to offense leaves Keicho vulnerable.

jojo.stand.ball_breaker.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.ball_breaker.trigger: The Steel Ball must be thrown with the Golden Spin, performed in sequence with Golden Rectangles held by both horse and rider, and Ball Breaker must touch the target to age it.
jojo.stand.ball_breaker.limit: The technique is flawed when used with an imperfect Steel Ball. The text gives no other cost or range.
jojo.stand.ball_breaker.summary: Ball Breaker channels energy gathered by throwing a Steel Ball with the Golden Spin, causing a target it touches to age dramatically; a human’s Stand ages as well. It can also bypass D4C - Love Train’s dimensional wall.

jojo.stand.bastet.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.bastet.trigger: A person must touch the outlet.
jojo.stand.bastet.limit: The magnetism grows gradually, and Mariah must stay within a certain distance of the target or it wears off.
jojo.stand.bastet.beaten_by: Move far enough away from Mariah for the magnetism to wear off.
jojo.stand.bastet.summary: After a person touches Bastet’s outlet, they are shocked and become magnetic, gradually attracting nearby metal with increasing force. People affected by the same curse also attract one another; the effect wears off if Mariah gets too far away.

jojo.stand.beach_boy.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.beach_boy.trigger: Pesci uses the fishing rod to search for and hook a target; damage reflection applies once the line is hooked into something or someone.
jojo.stand.beach_boy.limit: Its pulling strength is limited by Pesci’s arm strength. Dropping Beach Boy immediately cancels the ability and recalls the hook and line.
jojo.stand.beach_boy.beaten_by: Making Pesci drop Beach Boy cancels the ability.
jojo.stand.beach_boy.summary: Beach Boy sends an intangible hook and line through obstacles to sense and catch a target, then lets Pesci reel them in or injure them from within. Once hooked, damage to the line is instead inflicted on the catch.

jojo.stand.black_sabbath.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.black_sabbath.trigger: Someone holding Polpo’s lighter puts it out and then reignites it; Black Sabbath appears in the shadows and attacks witnesses automatically.
jojo.stand.black_sabbath.limit: Its movement is restricted to shadows, and sunlight harms it; it must reach a shadow to hide and escape. The text also says it is long-range and can be summoned again if beaten.
jojo.stand.black_sabbath.beaten_by: Sunlight exposes and weakens it; while exposed, it can be destroyed by physical attacks.
jojo.stand.black_sabbath.summary: Black Sabbath is an automated Stand that attacks witnesses when someone extinguishes and reignites Polpo’s lighter. It moves and hides through connected shadows, can pull a human’s soul or a Stand User’s Stand from their shadow, and carries an Arrow in its mouth to pierce targets.

jojo.stand.blue_hawaii.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.blue_hawaii.trigger: The initial target must physically touch something that was once attached to Dolomite. Further infections spread when an infected organism’s flesh or blood physically touches another organism.
jojo.stand.blue_hawaii.limit: Only one living being appears to be controlled at a time. Controlled victims can move only in a straight line toward their target and cannot climb over or avoid obstacles.
jojo.stand.blue_hawaii.beaten_by: Find and defeat Dolomite; obstruct the controlled victim’s straight-line path.
jojo.stand.blue_hawaii.summary: Blue Hawaii possesses a person or animal after physical contact with something once attached to Dolomite, then compels the victim to follow an instruction. An infected victim can pass the possession to another through physical contact with its flesh or blood, freeing itself when the infection transfers.

jojo.stand.bohemian_rhapsody.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.bohemian_rhapsody.trigger: A fictional character is depicted in media and brought into reality; a person who likes or recognizes that character, even subconsciously, may be pulled into its role.
jojo.stand.bohemian_rhapsody.limit: Its range is effectively worldwide. People with no knowledge of a story or character may be immune, but this is difficult to rely on; the story’s course cannot be changed, and the characters are difficult to destroy.
jojo.stand.bohemian_rhapsody.beaten_by: Destroy the fictional character responsible for pulling a person into its story to return their soul to their body. A character created specifically to eliminate fictional characters can cancel Bohemian Rhapsody.
jojo.stand.bohemian_rhapsody.summary: Bohemian Rhapsody brings characters depicted in media into reality; people who recognize and like a character can have their soul pulled into that character’s role, appearance, and written fate, separate from their body. Destroying the character that drew them into the story returns the soul, while a specially created character that eliminates fictional characters can cancel the ability.

jojo.stand.boku_no_rhythm_wo_kiitekure.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.boku_no_rhythm_wo_kiitekure.trigger: Oyecomova or the Stand touches a surface or medium to place a pin; after a while, the pin springs into the air.
jojo.stand.boku_no_rhythm_wo_kiitekure.limit: The pins can be stopped only by preventing them from springing. Holding them down is difficult, and combat sweat can make them slip loose.
jojo.stand.boku_no_rhythm_wo_kiitekure.beaten_by: Keep the pins from springing into the air; holding them down may work temporarily, but sweat can defeat it.
jojo.stand.boku_no_rhythm_wo_kiitekure.summary: On contact, the Stand attaches clock-topped bomb pins to almost any medium. After a delay, a pin springs into the air and explodes with great force.

jojo.stand.born_this_way.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.born_this_way.trigger: Kyo must have touched the chosen target, and an object must be opened while the Stand is eligible to appear near them. Opening can be accidental, but opening body parts such as eyes does not count.
jojo.stand.born_this_way.limit: It is independent of Kyo’s distance and can attack while she acts freely. It disappears when anyone closes the relevant open object; the text gives no other cost or range limit.
jojo.stand.born_this_way.beaten_by: Close the relevant open object to make it disappear; avoid opening objects to prevent it from appearing.
jojo.stand.born_this_way.summary: Kyo can mark a person by touching them; Born This Way appears near that person when they or someone else opens an object, then attacks with powerful freezing wind and ice. It disappears if anyone closes the object that triggered it.

jojo.stand.boy_ii_man.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.boy_ii_man.trigger: Ken proposes rock-paper-scissors and the opponent formally accepts; a Ken win in a round triggers a theft.
jojo.stand.boy_ii_man.limit: Draws must be replayed. The game ends if the opponent wins three times, returning the stolen energy. The description says a best-of-five game, but does not explain how that interacts with the three-win conditions.
jojo.stand.boy_ii_man.beaten_by: Cheating is allowed; Rohan used the invisible Shizuka to force Ken’s scissors hand into a rock hand.
jojo.stand.boy_ii_man.summary: After an opponent formally accepts Ken’s offer to play rock-paper-scissors, Boy II Man runs a best-of-five game. Each Ken win steals a third of the opponent’s energy and Stand, while three opponent wins return what was stolen and end the game; Ken also gains the Stand’s power as he steals it.

jojo.stand.brain_storm.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.brain_storm.trigger: The Stand must touch someone’s skin and attach its feelers.
jojo.stand.brain_storm.limit: Water can wash it away before it enters the body. Once it is inside, immediate amputation is required to prevent death.
jojo.stand.brain_storm.beaten_by: Wash it off with water before it penetrates the skin; after entry, amputation is the stated way to prevent death.
jojo.stand.brain_storm.summary: Brain Storm attaches to skin on contact, penetrates the body, and multiplies as it causes the victim’s body to break down. Once inside, it cannot be removed normally.

jojo.stand.burning_down_the_house.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.burning_down_the_house.trigger: Emporio uses the ability on ghosts of objects or rooms destroyed in the prison fire; entering the piano room requires an attuned person to pass through the crack in the stairway wall.
jojo.stand.burning_down_the_house.limit: Ghost objects may not work like ordinary objects: a ghost chocolate bar can be tasted but not eaten. The piano-room entrance is a slim crack, and people unaware of Emporio may overlook it.
jojo.stand.burning_down_the_house.summary: Burning Down the House lets Emporio see, touch, and use ghost versions of objects and rooms that were destroyed. Ghost objects have limited physical use, though he can carry them regardless of their size; the ghost piano room is accessible through a hidden crack in a wall.

jojo.stand.c_moon.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.c_moon.trigger: The gravity shift operates within 3 kilometers of Pucci. Surface inversion occurs when C-Moon's fists touch or graze something; touching the same object or area a second time reverses the effect. Localized time acceleration activates without warning when something touches or comes extremely close to Pucci.
jojo.stand.c_moon.limit: Pucci's control of the remote-controlled Stand improves with proximity, but he must expose himself to get closer. The time-acceleration effect is involuntary. C-Moon itself is unaffected by the gravity shift.
jojo.stand.c_moon.beaten_by: Jolyne can turn parts of her body into Möbius strips, which cannot be turned inside out; touching the same object or area twice also reverses surface inversion.
jojo.stand.c_moon.summary: C-Moon creates a gravity-shift zone around Pucci that repels people and objects, while its touch can invert an object's surface and reverse the effect if it touches the same area again. It also involuntarily accelerates the growth or development of things that touch or come extremely close to Pucci.

jojo.stand.california_king_bed.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.california_king_bed.trigger: Daiya must be sure the person is fussing over her, such as by showing concern for her or wariness of her.
jojo.stand.california_king_bed.limit: The stolen memory is random. Damaging a chess piece hurts the person it came from; destroying it makes the memory lost forever.
jojo.stand.california_king_bed.beaten_by: Having Daiya step on the target’s shadow returns the memory.
jojo.stand.california_king_bed.summary: When someone shows concern or wariness toward Daiya, California King Bed can remove one random memory from them, leaving them unable to remember it while retaining a sense that something is missing. The memory is stored in a chess piece that Daiya can inspect by touching; stepping on the target’s shadow restores it.

jojo.stand.catch_the_rainbow.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.catch_the_rainbow.trigger: Rain must be present; the Stand deactivates when the weather becomes clear.
jojo.stand.catch_the_rainbow.limit: Its abilities depend on rain, and plugging wounds only temporarily stops bleeding.
jojo.stand.catch_the_rainbow.summary: Catch the Rainbow lets Blackmore manipulate raindrops: he can halt and harden them to walk on, deflect attacks, or form cutting hazards, and can meld with rain to evade attacks or move quickly. He can also temporarily plug wounds with raindrops.

jojo.stand.chariot_requiem.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.chariot_requiem.trigger: Activates to protect the Arrow; a user trying to take or affect the Arrow triggers a proportional attack by their own Stand.
jojo.stand.chariot_requiem.limit: Its sleep and soul-switching affect a large area around it, stated to include at least all of Rome. Transformations develop over time. The text gives no other cost.
jojo.stand.chariot_requiem.beaten_by: A Stand can destroy the marble emitting the psychic light behind an observer’s head to defeat Chariot Requiem.
jojo.stand.chariot_requiem.summary: Chariot Requiem acts automatically to protect the Arrow, putting nearby living beings to sleep and switching each soul with the soul in the closest body. It can also empower or turn Stands against users who threaten the Arrow, and prolonged exposure causes bodily and soul transformation.

jojo.stand.cheap_trick.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.cheap_trick.trigger: It attaches to a host; if someone sees the host’s back, Cheap Trick detaches, kills the host, and attaches to the person who looked.
jojo.stand.cheap_trick.limit: It is too weak to do much physical damage, cannot be removed forcibly without killing the host, and the host cannot attack it without harming themselves.
jojo.stand.cheap_trick.beaten_by: The malicious spirits of the Ghost Girl’s Alley may be able to remove it safely.
jojo.stand.cheap_trick.summary: Cheap Trick attaches to a host’s back and autonomously pesters them while trying to make someone else see their back. If someone does, it kills the host, drains their life force, and transfers to the person who looked; it can also speak to anyone, including animals.

jojo.stand.chocolate_disco.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.chocolate_disco.trigger: D-I-S-C-O activates the ability and presses the grid coordinates on his armband for a flying projectile or object.
jojo.stand.chocolate_disco.limit: The grid extends about twenty feet in front of him. He must select the correct coordinates; a miss leaves him defenseless at close range, and the ability cannot directly harm someone without objects to use.
jojo.stand.chocolate_disco.beaten_by: Close-range pressure or causing him to miss the intended grid coordinates.
jojo.stand.chocolate_disco.summary: Chocolate Disco lets D-I-S-C-O use an armband grid to teleport flying objects to selected grid spaces, making them fall there. He can redirect incoming projectiles as well as attack with objects such as nails or acid.

jojo.stand.cinderella.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.cinderella.trigger: For body-part replacement, the client must remain immobile. Permanent enhancements require applying special lipstick every 30 minutes for 24 hours, except while sleeping.
jojo.stand.cinderella.limit: Cinderella is used for cosmetic work. Most changes last only 30 minutes; permanent enhancements depend on lipstick maintenance. Failing to apply it on time deforms the recipient’s face and causes modified features to gradually disappear.
jojo.stand.cinderella.beaten_by: Moving during a replacement may cause Aya to botch it. Missing a required lipstick application triggers deformation and gradual loss of the changes; Aya can repair the body if she wills it.
jojo.stand.cinderella.summary: Cinderella replaces or reshapes body features to influence a client’s appearance and fate, including their love life. Temporary changes last 30 minutes; permanent changes require regular lipstick applications to preserve them.

jojo.stand.civil_war.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.civil_war.trigger: A target feels guilt toward, or has left behind or given up, a person or object. For revival, someone inside Civil War’s range must die and their killer must feel at least slight guilt.
jojo.stand.civil_war.limit: Civil War is otherwise combat-incapable and is restricted to the garbage dump, though specters can pursue targets outside it. Water dissolves the membrane. The guiltier the target, the more manifestations may appear.
jojo.stand.civil_war.beaten_by: Douse the membrane with water; kill without guilt, or mortally wound the victim and escape before they die.
jojo.stand.civil_war.summary: Civil War manifests people and things its target abandoned or feels guilty about; they attack and may form a shrinking membrane that crushes the target. If someone inside its range dies and the killer feels guilt, the victim revives as a specter and the victim’s guilt and sins turn against the killer.

jojo.stand.clash.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.clash.trigger: Clash is occupying a liquid and there is another sufficiently large, unsealed body of liquid within about 2–3 meters.
jojo.stand.clash.limit: It must stay in liquid except for brief attacks; sealed liquids are unavailable, and injury can slow its transfer. Its size varies with the liquid’s surface area.
jojo.stand.clash.beaten_by: Sealing the destination liquid, keeping it beyond 2–3 meters, or injuring Clash to slow its transfer.
jojo.stand.clash.summary: Clash must remain in liquid, where it can teleport between nearby liquid bodies and emerge to attack. It can carry a person or object along when it transfers, and its apparent size depends on the liquid it occupies.

jojo.stand.crazy_diamond.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.crazy_diamond.trigger: Crazy Diamond must touch the object or organism to restore it.
jojo.stand.crazy_diamond.limit: Its effective range is short (about 2 meters). It cannot heal Josuke, cure illness, restore erased things, or bring the dead back to life.
jojo.stand.crazy_diamond.beaten_by: A foul mood can cause an improper, warped restoration.
jojo.stand.crazy_diamond.summary: Crazy Diamond restores damaged objects and living organisms through touch, repairing injuries, reversing changes, and reassembling or fusing parts. Josuke can direct where separated pieces gather; restoration may be warped if he is in a foul mood.

jojo.stand.cream.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.cream.trigger: Vanilla Ice has Cream devour itself and him, making Cream enter its spherical void state.
jojo.stand.cream.limit: Cream is short-ranged. While inside the void state, Vanilla Ice is blind to his surroundings and must periodically peek out, briefly becoming vulnerable.
jojo.stand.cream.beaten_by: Scattering sand can reveal the sphere’s path; attacking when Vanilla Ice peeks out can exploit his brief vulnerability.
jojo.stand.cream.summary: Cream swallows itself and Vanilla Ice to become a fast-moving portal sphere that transports matter it passes through into another dimension, effectively cutting or disintegrating it. In this state, it is invulnerable and difficult to detect, but Vanilla Ice cannot see outside and must briefly emerge to look.

jojo.stand.cream_starter.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.cream_starter.trigger: Hot Pants sprays flesh; for larger uses she can use her own flesh or absorb another person's flesh by direct touch. The sprayed flesh affects someone when it touches them.
jojo.stand.cream_starter.limit: The spray reaches tens of meters, though Hot Pants usually uses it nearby; small uses may require no flesh. Pain felt by a detached body part transfers to Hot Pants.
jojo.stand.cream_starter.summary: Cream Starter sprays flesh that re-solidifies when it touches someone, where it can harm, heal, disguise, or otherwise affect the target. Hot Pants can also turn her own body or detached parts into spray to move through tight spaces or attack from unexpected angles.

jojo.stand.dark_blue_moon.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.dark_blue_moon.trigger: Barnacles attach when a target contacts Dark Blue Moon’s skin.
jojo.stand.dark_blue_moon.limit: Its abilities are more effective in water; its effectiveness on land is unknown. The user can hold their breath for a personal record of six minutes and twelve seconds.
jojo.stand.dark_blue_moon.summary: Dark Blue Moon fights with sharp hands and thrown scales, and can create barnacles that drain a target’s strength and give it slight control over the affected body parts. It swims extremely fast and can create a whirlpool by rapidly spinning its webbed feet.

jojo.stand.dark_mirage.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.dark_mirage.limit: It is powerless without light, such as at night or in a sandstorm.
jojo.stand.dark_mirage.summary: Dark Mirage materializes mirages, manipulates them freely, and can make them real objects that attack while still defying logic, such as floating castles. It requires light to use its powers.

jojo.stand.death_thirteen.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.death_thirteen.trigger: A living being must fall asleep near Mannish Boy; an active Stand can enter if it was active before the user fell asleep. Someone else can wake a victim from the dream.
jojo.stand.death_thirteen.limit: Death Thirteen only exists in the dream world. Its user is defenseless while everyone is awake. In the dream it is fragile and physically weak, relying on scythe sweeps to wound.
jojo.stand.death_thirteen.beaten_by: A Stand brought into the dream can fight Death Thirteen; Hierophant Green defeated it. Waking the victim can save them temporarily.
jojo.stand.death_thirteen.summary: When a living being falls asleep near Mannish Boy, Death Thirteen draws them into a dream world it controls, where it can shape the surroundings and inflict or heal injuries that carry over to the real world. Victims normally cannot summon their Stands or remember the dream after waking, though an active Stand can enter with its user and another person can wake them.

jojo.stand.dirty_deeds_done_dirt_cheap.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.dirty_deeds_done_dirt_cheap.trigger: Valentine places even an infinitesimal part of himself between two objects to hop dimensions. To move someone else, he must force them between two objects or into an object used as a portal.
jojo.stand.dirty_deeds_done_dirt_cheap.limit: Moving another person or item requires this object-based access. Only one version of a person or thing can safely coexist in a dimension; duplicates that get too close may crumble and cause an explosion. Valentine himself is exempt.
jojo.stand.dirty_deeds_done_dirt_cheap.summary: D4C lets Valentine travel between parallel dimensions, reappear through objects, and force people or items between worlds by pressing them between objects. It can also bring alternate Valentines into a target dimension; duplicate versions of the same person or thing cannot safely coexist there and may crumble if they get too close.

jojo.stand.diver_down.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.diver_down.trigger: It must strike an object to store a blow, which Anasui can release at will; to restructure a target, Diver Down must plunge inside it.
jojo.stand.diver_down.limit: It is a close-range Stand. The text gives no further cost or range for storing or releasing blows.
jojo.stand.diver_down.summary: Diver Down can store the force of its blows in an object and release it later, or enter a person or solid object to rearrange its internal structure. It can also absorb damage for a person it inhabits or replace a lost limb.

jojo.stand.doctor_wu.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.doctor_wu.trigger: Tomoki breaks apart into gravel; parasitizing a person appears to require a particular rock acting as a beacon. An allergic reaction can occur if the gravel is inhaled.
jojo.stand.doctor_wu.limit: The particles have no power beyond floating with the wind, and the granular form limits Tomoki's ability to act and can leave him stuck in new objects.
jojo.stand.doctor_wu.beaten_by: New objects can trap him while he is in gravel form.
jojo.stand.doctor_wu.summary: Doctor Wu can break Tomoki's body into independently controlled gravel particles and later reconstruct him. The gravel can infiltrate a person and, apparently using a particular rock as a beacon, paralyze them and control their movements; inhaled gravel can also trigger an allergic reaction, and it can carry added substances such as sleeping pills.

jojo.stand.doggy_style.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.doggy_style.trigger: Rai chooses to unravel his body.
jojo.stand.doggy_style.limit: Its full capabilities are unknown; in the described use, his eyes and teeth remain unraveled-free.
jojo.stand.doggy_style.summary: Doggy Style lets Rai unravel parts or nearly all of his own body into controllable wire-like appendages, which he can use to reach, cut, or launch objects.

jojo.stand.dolly_dagger.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked

novel_sheet.name: Dolly Dagger
novel_sheet.source: Purple Smoke Distortion (Kadono), chapter-end Stand sheet

jojo.stand.dolly_dagger.trigger: Vittorio takes damage, including self-inflicted damage, and someone is reflected in the dagger.
jojo.stand.dolly_dagger.limit: Vittorio still takes 30% of the damage. The reflected target receives the damage level at the corresponding location, not necessarily the same physical injury.
jojo.stand.dolly_dagger.beaten_by: Stands with multiple bodies can withstand the reflected damage better than Vittorio.
jojo.stand.dolly_dagger.summary: When Vittorio takes damage, 70% of its damage level is transferred to the person reflected in the dagger, while Vittorio takes the remaining 30%. The reflected damage affects the corresponding body location and ignores defenses like armor; self-inflicted damage can also be reflected.

jojo.stand.doobie_wah.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.doobie_wah.trigger: Aisho must touch the target or their Stand to set Doobie Wah! after them; it manifests near the target through their exhalation.
jojo.stand.doobie_wah.limit: The vortex can weaken and disappear if separated from the target, such as by a sealed window. Holding their breath can temporarily hide the target from it, but only for as long as they can hold their breath.
jojo.stand.doobie_wah.beaten_by: Attack Aisho, or temporarily avoid detection by holding their breath; separating the vortex from the target can make it weaken and disappear.
jojo.stand.doobie_wah.summary: After Aisho touches a person or their Stand, Doobie Wah! automatically pursues and attacks that target, appearing near them through their exhalation as a destructive tornado. It can pursue multiple targets and reappear after they escape the vortex.

jojo.stand.dragon_s_dream.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.dragon_s_dream.trigger: Kenzou reads the compass to locate a lucky spot or an unlucky spot. An unlucky spot can be exploited by striking into Dragon’s Dream’s sphere or by making the target touch it.
jojo.stand.dragon_s_dream.limit: Dragon’s Dream cannot attack or be attacked, and it advises the target how to defend. Kenzou must position himself and make the strike; misleading him about the coordinates can leave him vulnerable.
jojo.stand.dragon_s_dream.beaten_by: Trick Kenzou into misreading the coordinates, or protect against the indicated strike.
jojo.stand.dragon_s_dream.summary: Dragon’s Dream acts as a neutral compass that identifies lucky positions where Kenzou can evade attacks and unlucky points where his strikes can hit a mortal area or cause an accidental injury. It also tells the target where danger is coming from and how to defend against it.

jojo.stand.earth_wind_and_fire.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.earth_wind_and_fire.trigger: Mikitaka needs a precise idea of what he is transforming into and some concentration to control the change.
jojo.stand.earth_wind_and_fire.limit: He cannot reproduce complex items or objects that require more strength than his own to operate, and he cannot convincingly copy a person's appearance. Inaccurate ideas produce inaccurate forms; panic can make the change random and eventually force him back to human form. His bodily weaknesses and behavior persist while transformed.
jojo.stand.earth_wind_and_fire.beaten_by: Panic, such as from hearing a siren, can disrupt his control and cause the transformation to become random.
jojo.stand.earth_wind_and_fire.summary: Mikitaka can reshape his body into one or more objects, copying their appearance, weight, and texture and taking on some of their properties. He can also partially reverse the change.

jojo.stand.ebony_devil.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.ebony_devil.trigger: Devo must first be hit by his foe; its strength depends on his hatred of that foe and the damage he received.
jojo.stand.ebony_devil.limit: It must transfer to a physical object to attack, and damage to that object is reflected on Devo.
jojo.stand.ebony_devil.summary: Ebony Devil activates after Devo is hit by his foe, growing stronger according to Devo’s hatred and the damage he has taken. It can possess a physical object such as a doll, attack the foe from a distance, and let Devo see through the object’s eyes; damage to the object is reflected on Devo.

jojo.stand.echoes.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.echoes.trigger: ACT1's writing produces sounds or influences a person's state of mind; ACT2's sound effect activates when touched. ACT3 must punch its target to apply 3 Freeze.
jojo.stand.echoes.limit: ACT1 can operate up to about 50 meters away, but is weak and slow. ACT2 can use only one sound effect at a time. ACT3 affects only one target, and its effect ends if the target moves more than 5 meters from it; targets feel heavier when closer.
jojo.stand.echoes.beaten_by: Sufficient willpower can dispel ACT1's writing.
jojo.stand.echoes.summary: Echoes writes sound effects or words onto people and surfaces, producing related sounds or effects when triggered; its later form can instead punch one target to greatly increase its weight and pin it down.

jojo.stand.emperor.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.emperor.trigger: Hol Horse summons or fires Emperor’s bullets and controls their trajectory.
jojo.stand.emperor.limit: The bullets remain subject to Emperor’s range, and their effectiveness drops rapidly near its limit.
jojo.stand.emperor.beaten_by: Keeping out of Emperor’s effective range.
jojo.stand.emperor.summary: Emperor acts as Hol Horse’s gun, whose bullets he can steer precisely along changing paths, even around obstacles. He can also summon the Stand directly into his hand for a quick attack.

jojo.stand.empress.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.empress.trigger: Nena’s blood must make direct contact with a person to plant Empress. It grows while it can feed on exterior food sources.
jojo.stand.empress.limit: It grows gradually and needs food from outside its host. Only a Stand can harm it; ordinary people see it as a wart, though they can hear it.
jojo.stand.empress.beaten_by: A Stand can harm it, and coating it with tar can immobilize it.
jojo.stand.empress.summary: After Nena’s blood directly contacts a person, Empress buds from the splattered area and grows by feeding on outside food. As it develops, it acts against its host; if it fully assimilates them, Nena can hide inside the victim and use them as a disguise.

jojo.stand.enigma.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.enigma.trigger: Simple objects and animals can be transformed directly. To capture a person, the user must witness and identify their fear tell with certainty, then activate the ability when the person displays it again.
jojo.stand.enigma.limit: The user must keep the paper folded to keep its contents trapped. Damage to the paper causes equivalent damage to what is sealed inside.
jojo.stand.enigma.beaten_by: Anyone can unfold the paper to release its contents; damaging the paper also harms what is trapped inside.
jojo.stand.enigma.summary: Enigma transforms objects and people into patterned paper that holds them until someone unfolds it. To capture a person, the user must first identify their fear tell, then activate the ability when they display it; the user can also turn himself into paper and hover or return to normal.

jojo.stand.foo_fighters.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.foo_fighters.trigger: Its colony abilities work while plankton survives; rapid multiplication and regeneration require water. Body invasion requires infiltrating a person. The text says plankton shots are used inside a host.
jojo.stand.foo_fighters.limit: It needs constant water to survive outside a host and rapidly dies if dehydrated. In a host, it has reduced agility and can lose moisture through bleeding.
jojo.stand.foo_fighters.beaten_by: Dehydration or damage to the whole colony can threaten it; in a host, bleeding can cause it to lose moisture.
jojo.stand.foo_fighters.summary: Foo Fighters is a sentient plankton colony that can split into independently acting sub-bodies, rapidly regenerate in water, manipulate water, and attack with its mass or plankton shots. It can also invade a person to take over their consciousness and memories, disguise itself as them, and help seal wounds.

jojo.stand.fun_fun_fun.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.fun_fun_fun.trigger: Ojiro must be physically above the target and conscious of their position. Initially, the target must be injured while under Fun Fun Fun for the corresponding limb to be marked; later, it can mark a limb without injury.
jojo.stand.fun_fun_fun.limit: Only marked limbs are controlled; unmarked body parts can still move, and the target can still talk. Ojiro loses control if he loses track of the target’s position.
jojo.stand.fun_fun_fun.beaten_by: Concealing or obscuring the target’s position from Ojiro can disrupt his control.
jojo.stand.fun_fun_fun.summary: Fun Fun Fun lets Ojiro control an injured limb after its mark appears, and can control a target’s movement if all four extremities are marked. Later, it can place a mark without an injury.

jojo.stand.geb.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.geb.trigger: N'Doul controls Geb; vibration or sound sensing is used to detect distant activity.
jojo.stand.geb.limit: Its water form is vulnerable to heat, which can evaporate it and wound N'Doul.
jojo.stand.geb.beaten_by: Heat or flames can partially evaporate Geb.
jojo.stand.geb.summary: Geb is a water Stand that N'Doul can control precisely from far away. It can twist to evade attacks, strike or cut targets, shield against projectiles, and use vibrations or moving sand to detect sound.

jojo.stand.gold_experience.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.gold_experience.trigger: Gold Experience must touch the target with its fists; the life-giving transformation cannot work in an environment absolutely unsuitable for life.
jojo.stand.gold_experience.limit: The Stand has a range of 2 meters. Transformations can take time depending on the size and complexity of the life form; created animals are not under Giorno’s control and may act unpredictably.
jojo.stand.gold_experience.beaten_by: An environment absolutely unsuitable for life prevents the creation of life forms.
jojo.stand.gold_experience.summary: Gold Experience gives life to things its fists touch, usually transforming inorganic objects into plants or animals, and can later undo the change. It can also alter living targets’ perception and lifespan, create body parts, and has been shown cloning an organism.

jojo.stand.gold_experience_requiem.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.gold_experience_requiem.trigger: It can affect actions or willpower within its influence, which the text says can extend from surface contact to being in its attention field. The repeated-death effect occurs if the opponent is attacked by GER.
jojo.stand.gold_experience_requiem.limit: Its exact workings and limits are unknown. It is described as a close-range Stand, though its influence can extend to GER’s attention field.
jojo.stand.gold_experience_requiem.beaten_by: No counter is stated; the text says its power trumps King Crimson’s time erasure.
jojo.stand.gold_experience_requiem.summary: Gold Experience Requiem resets actions and willpower to “zero,” nullifying them before they can become real. An opponent it attacks can also be trapped in repeated deaths, returning each time to the moment before death.

jojo.stand.goo_goo_dolls.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.goo_goo_dolls.trigger: The person must be within Goo Goo Dolls' range; the text hints that Gwess must desire friendship and control over them.
jojo.stand.goo_goo_dolls.limit: Its shrinking works only within range, and the victim grows back when far enough from Gwess.
jojo.stand.goo_goo_dolls.beaten_by: Getting far enough from Gwess causes the victim to grow back.
jojo.stand.goo_goo_dolls.summary: Goo Goo Dolls instantly shrinks a targeted person to mouse size. If the shrunken person gets far enough from Gwess, they continuously grow back.

jojo.stand.green_day.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.green_day.trigger: Mold must infect a living target, which triggers growth when the target or one of its limbs moves to a lower altitude.
jojo.stand.green_day.limit: It does not affect nonliving bodies or Stands. Growth is faster at lower altitudes and stops if the victim rises before it is too late; the mold can spread onward from corpses.
jojo.stand.green_day.beaten_by: Increase altitude before the mold consumes the victim.
jojo.stand.green_day.summary: Green Day releases mold that infects living things and rapidly rots their flesh when they lower their altitude; the lower they go, the faster it spreads. Moving upward before the mold finishes spreading stops its growth, and it can spread from corpse to corpse.

jojo.stand.green_green_grass_of_home.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.green_green_grass_of_home.trigger: Being within the undisclosed range around the Green Baby causes shrinking based on proximity; getting close to the vanishing point triggers the Stand's attack.
jojo.stand.green_green_grass_of_home.limit: The shrinking effect fades as a target moves away. The range is undisclosed; a target the Baby chooses to touch or pick up returns to normal size.
jojo.stand.green_green_grass_of_home.beaten_by: Moving away from the Baby reverses the shrinking; no other counter is stated.
jojo.stand.green_green_grass_of_home.summary: Things near the Green Baby shrink in proportion to how close they are, and grow back as they move away; approaching the vanishing point causes the Stand to manifest and attack. If the Baby chooses to touch or pick up someone, that person returns to normal size.

jojo.stand.hanged_man.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.hanged_man.trigger: A target's reflection is reachable from Hanged Man's current reflective surface.
jojo.stand.hanged_man.limit: It must travel linearly between reflective surfaces and moves to another reflection in front of it if its current surface stops reflecting. It is vulnerable while in transit.
jojo.stand.hanged_man.beaten_by: Break or block a reflective surface to force a predictable route, then hit Hanged Man while it is in transit.
jojo.stand.hanged_man.summary: Hanged Man moves between reflective surfaces and attacks a person's reflection with wrist knives, causing the person to suffer the attack. It can travel through reflections at the speed of light, but must follow a linear route from one reflection to another.

jojo.stand.harvest.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.harvest.trigger: Shigechi commands the units to search, collect, attack, dismantle, or inject.
jojo.stand.harvest.limit: The units are individually weak and can carry only light items. Destroying units has little effect on Shigechi because damage is divided among the 500 units.
jojo.stand.harvest.summary: Harvest consists of 500 small, fast units that Shigechi commands over a very large area. They can search for and return light items of a specified type, swarm and attack targets, dismantle objects, and inject liquids into opponents with their needles.

jojo.stand.heaven_s_door.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.heaven_s_door.trigger: Initially, a target must see Heaven’s Door or an image of it. Later, Rohan can summon the Stand and approach people to affect them. Writing a command requires the target to be transformed into a book.
jojo.stand.heaven_s_door.limit: It is a close-range Stand. Rohan cannot read his own memories or memories he shares with the target. If he is substantially injured or nearly unconscious, removed pages automatically return to their source.
jojo.stand.heaven_s_door.beaten_by: In its introductory form, closing one’s eyes or being unable to process the image makes a target immune.
jojo.stand.heaven_s_door.summary: Heaven’s Door turns people into books, letting Rohan read their memories and details. He can remove pages to erase memories or write commands into the pages that the subject must obey; the book-form can also be used to alter the subject’s body.

jojo.stand.hermit_purple.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.hermit_purple.trigger: Joseph uses the vines with an object or material to reveal information; he can also control the vines as ropes or transmit Ripple through them.
jojo.stand.hermit_purple.limit: The vines are relatively weak and can be broken by a sufficiently strong Stand or a strong Vampire.
jojo.stand.hermit_purple.beaten_by: A sufficiently strong Stand or a strong Vampire can break the vines.
jojo.stand.hermit_purple.summary: Hermit Purple can reveal information Joseph seeks through an object or material, producing images, video, analysis, or maps. Its vines can also be controlled as ropes, and can transmit Joseph’s Ripple to attack or ward off contact.

jojo.stand.hey_ya.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.hey_ya.trigger: It accompanies Pocoloco and offers advice or encouragement; no specific activation condition is stated.
jojo.stand.hey_ya.limit: It has no combat ability and does not improve Pocoloco’s luck.
jojo.stand.hey_ya.summary: Hey Ya! whispers advice and encouragement to Pocoloco, improving his mood and confidence without changing his luck. It can also foresee certain near-future events well enough to warn him.

jojo.stand.hierophant_green.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.hierophant_green.trigger: Kakyoin controls how the Stand unravels; a string can attack when someone touches it or on Kakyoin’s command. Person-control requires its coils to enter the person’s body. The Emerald Splash requires Hierophant Green to gather energy before firing.
jojo.stand.hierophant_green.limit: Hierophant Green is relatively weak in hand-to-hand combat. A broken string does not harm Kakyoin, but enough strings being attacked or damage to the main body does. The text gives no specific cost for the Emerald Splash.
jojo.stand.hierophant_green.beaten_by: Star Platinum or a Vampire can block or deflect the Emerald Splash.
jojo.stand.hierophant_green.summary: Hierophant Green can unravel into ropes or sensitive strings that detect contact and attack, and it can coil inside a person to control them. It can also gather energy and fire a fast, powerful emerald-like barrage.

jojo.stand.high_priestess.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.high_priestess.trigger: Midler commands High Priestess; it can assimilate inorganic material to transform or grow.
jojo.stand.high_priestess.limit: Its size and reach when enlarged depend on how much material it can assimilate. Midler is vulnerable if High Priestess is defeated.
jojo.stand.high_priestess.beaten_by: Defeating High Priestess can take Midler out of danger.
jojo.stand.high_priestess.summary: High Priestess can transform into and blend with inorganic materials, imitate complex objects, and emerge elsewhere to attack. It can grow larger by assimilating more material, while Midler commands it from a distance.

jojo.stand.highway_star.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.highway_star.trigger: A victim enters the created room to be marked by scent; life draining occurs when any part of Highway Star touches the victim.
jojo.stand.highway_star.limit: It chases at up to 60 km/h. Split pieces act automatically and mindlessly follow the scent, so the target can temporarily trick them.
jojo.stand.highway_star.beaten_by: While split, it can be temporarily tricked by misleading its scent trail; Josuke escaped the Stand to find and defeat Yuya.
jojo.stand.highway_star.summary: Highway Star can create an illusory room that lures victims in; anyone who enters is scent-marked, after which the Stand can automatically chase them and drain life energy on contact, transferring it to Yuya to heal him. It can also split into independently moving pieces that follow the scent and reassemble.

jojo.stand.highway_to_hell.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.highway_to_hell.trigger: McQueen must attempt to kill himself and apply Highway to Hell to someone.
jojo.stand.highway_to_hell.limit: It has no combat ability apart from sharing McQueen’s self-inflicted harm; fleeing from him does not stop the effect.
jojo.stand.highway_to_hell.beaten_by: Stop McQueen from killing himself or take away the DISC.
jojo.stand.highway_to_hell.summary: When McQueen attempts to kill himself, Highway to Hell makes a linked target suffer the same kind of harm and take the same pose. The Stand manifests the harm on the target’s body.

jojo.stand.horus.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.horus.limit: Its attacks are ice-based; the text says its power is more efficient in humid environments.
jojo.stand.horus.summary: Horus lets Pet Shop rapidly generate ice and use it for ranged or close attacks, barriers, trapping targets, wound freezing, and sharper talons. Humidity makes its ice generation more efficient.

jojo.stand.i_am_a_rock.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.i_am_a_rock.trigger: Yotsuyu must touch the target to activate the effect and choose the type of object attracted.
jojo.stand.i_am_a_rock.limit: The effect has a range of 5–10 meters; the target can escape by leaving that range. Each activation attracts only one type of object.
jojo.stand.i_am_a_rock.summary: After Yotsuyu touches a target, he makes one chosen type of object converge on them, accelerating and strengthening until the objects force their way into the target. He can affect multiple people with the same object type, or himself, and can toggle the effect on himself.

jojo.stand.in_a_silent_way.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.in_a_silent_way.trigger: A sound is stored by affecting an object with the corresponding action; the hazard releases when something touches the object. Constructs can be formed and directed when Sandman affects an object.
jojo.stand.in_a_silent_way.limit: The ability is subpar at close range. Materials can dampen or enhance sound attacks; water is described as the best medium for sending them.
jojo.stand.in_a_silent_way.beaten_by: Close-range attacks can exploit the ability's weakness; materials that dampen sound can weaken its attacks.
jojo.stand.in_a_silent_way.summary: Sandman stores a sound-linked hazard in an object, which releases when something touches it. He can also shape sound and nearby material into moving constructs that direct attacks or deflect projectiles.

jojo.stand.jail_house_lock.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.jail_house_lock.trigger: A person or their Stand touches bars or walls beyond the prison visiting room, or Miu Miu targets them with the Stand.
jojo.stand.jail_house_lock.limit: The victim retains memories from before activation. The text says several dozen people can be affected at once.
jojo.stand.jail_house_lock.beaten_by: Group new information into a single fact rather than learning each detail separately, such as treating the bullets’ reflection in a mirror as one fact.
jojo.stand.jail_house_lock.summary: Jail House Lock makes each victim able to retain only the three most recently learned pieces of new information; learning a fourth causes them to forget the oldest. This disrupts complex tasks and can leave them distracted and unable to act effectively.

jojo.stand.jojosapiens.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.jojosapiens.limit: The description gives no details about how the human is created or any costs, range, or weaknesses.
jojo.stand.jojosapiens.summary: JoJosapiens gathers data from JoJo fans and uses it to create a human, who becomes the Stand’s User and takes control of the Stand. The text does not explain the creation process or what the Stand can do.

jojo.stand.joy_division.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.joy_division.trigger: The user touches objects with both hands and activates the swap, immediately or at a chosen future time.
jojo.stand.joy_division.limit: The text shows delays of at least three hours but gives no maximum delay or other limit.
jojo.stand.joy_division.summary: Joy Division swaps the objects touched by its right and left hands, repositioning them relative to each other; it can also delay a swap after touching both objects.

jojo.stand.judgement.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.judgement.trigger: A person's deepest desire or wish provides the basis for the construct; the text describes Judgement tricking Polnareff into wishing for his sister to return.
jojo.stand.judgement.limit: The constructs are imitations, not genuine returned people. Judgement can be overcome by greater brute force.
jojo.stand.judgement.beaten_by: Brute-force Stands such as Magician's Red.
jojo.stand.judgement.summary: Judgement forms clay imitations from a person's deepest desires, then turns the wish against them—for example, making an imitation of a loved one attack. The imitations can convincingly reproduce objects or people, including a person's appearance, voice, and memories.

jojo.stand.jumpin_jack_flash.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.jumpin_jack_flash.trigger: Spitting on someone triggers weightlessness for them and anything or anyone they touch. Lang can also freely toggle weightlessness for particular people and objects; he can summon his centrifuges on his wrists to use them.
jojo.stand.jumpin_jack_flash.limit: The vacuum develops around the victim and endangers Lang as well as the victim, so Lang must stay away. The centrifuges require small physical objects as ammunition and need regular reloading.
jojo.stand.jumpin_jack_flash.beaten_by: The text says Weather Report's power could temporarily counter the effects, and Weather Report and Stone Free working together defeated Lang.
jojo.stand.jumpin_jack_flash.summary: When Lang Rangler spits on someone, they and anything or anyone they touch lose the effects of gravity. This creates a spreading weightless zone that develops into a roughly 20-meter vacuum; Lang can also toggle weightlessness for selected people or objects and launch stored small objects from wrist-mounted centrifuges as bullets.

jojo.stand.justice.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.justice.trigger: For puppetry, the target must have an open wound; Justice absorbs the flowing blood and makes a hole for a fog thread to enter. Illusions can be manifested within Justice’s range.
jojo.stand.justice.limit: Puppetry is described as controlling associated body parts through the holes. Illusions are limited to Justice’s range.
jojo.stand.justice.summary: Justice uses fog threads through a wounded target’s body to control the affected body parts like a puppet. It can also create realistic illusions within its range, including disguising places and people.

jojo.stand.khnum.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.khnum.trigger: Oingo chooses to alter his appearance at will.
jojo.stand.khnum.beaten_by: The text says Oingo was foiled by bad luck.
jojo.stand.khnum.summary: Khnum lets Oingo reshape his own appearance, including his height, weight, scent, and presumably voice, while leaving his clothes unchanged. He can also alter his hair and says he can undo the changes.

jojo.stand.killer_queen.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.killer_queen.trigger: Killer Queen must touch an object to charge it. Kira or Killer Queen must press the right thumb against the middle phalanx of the index finger to trigger the bomb; alternatively, someone else touching the charged object detonates it on them automatically.
jojo.stand.killer_queen.limit: Only one object can be charged at a time, and the bomb cannot detonate without air. Kira can vary the explosion's strength and the body parts it destroys.
jojo.stand.killer_queen.beaten_by: Prevent the triggering finger gesture, or create a vacuum around the bomb.
jojo.stand.killer_queen.summary: Killer Queen charges one touched object as a bomb. Kira can trigger it with a specific finger gesture, sending an explosion through whoever touched the charged object; another person's earlier touch instead detonates the object on them and consumes the charge.

jojo.stand.killer_queen_yoshikage_ki.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.killer_queen_yoshikage_ki.trigger: A bubble explodes when it contacts something; an internally placed bubble forms when Killer Queen physically strikes a person or object. Sheer Heart Attack detonates, but the text does not specify its trigger.
jojo.stand.killer_queen_yoshikage_ki.limit: Killer Queen is close-range and stays near Kira. Sheer Heart Attack’s blast strength depends on its size.
jojo.stand.killer_queen_yoshikage_ki.summary: Killer Queen creates explosive bubbles that detonate on contact, including inside a target if it strikes them. It can also produce miniature tank-like bombs that Kira remotely steers; their blast strength depends on their size.

jojo.stand.king_crimson.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.king_crimson.trigger: Diavolo activates time erasure; Epitaph forecasts up to ten seconds ahead.
jojo.stand.king_crimson.limit: Time erasure lasts at most ten seconds, and King Crimson cannot attack while it is active. Epitaph’s visions show the result without the steps and can be misinterpreted. King Crimson has an effective range of about 2–3 meters.
jojo.stand.king_crimson.beaten_by: Stands whose powers affect time can counter King Crimson. A fate-affecting Stand can make Epitaph’s vision false; King Crimson can also prevent a prediction from completing by erasing the relevant timeframe.
jojo.stand.king_crimson.summary: When activated, King Crimson erases up to ten seconds: others experience and remember nothing from that interval, while Diavolo remains conscious and can reposition himself. Epitaph can show Diavolo and Doppio an incomplete forecast of the next ten seconds, but King Crimson cannot attack during erased time.

jojo.stand.king_nothing.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.king_nothing.trigger: It must be exposed to an object to memorize its scent; it can then follow the scent or wait for it to attract it.
jojo.stand.king_nothing.limit: It has little physical power and is unsuitable for open fights; its range and other limits are unclear.
jojo.stand.king_nothing.summary: King Nothing records a person’s or object’s scent from an exposed item, then can automatically follow that scent or remain dormant until it detects it. It can split into jigsaw pieces to pass through narrow spaces and assemble a likeness of what it is tracking using nearby clothing or surfaces the target touched.

jojo.stand.kiss.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.kiss.trigger: Placing a sticker on an object creates the copy; removing or destroying the sticker triggers the objects to rush together and fuse.
jojo.stand.kiss.limit: Kiss is short-range, though the copy can be taken any distance from the original and their return is unaffected by surrounding conditions or attached weight.
jojo.stand.kiss.summary: Kiss lets Ermes place a sticker on an object to make an exact copy; on a person, it makes a corresponding body part sprout as an extra part. Removing or destroying the sticker makes the two objects rush together and fuse with great force, damaging them.

jojo.stand.kraft_work.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.kraft_work.trigger: Sale must touch an object to lock it; touching a locked object repeatedly builds energy before release. It can also partially immobilize people who contact something it has affected.
jojo.stand.kraft_work.limit: There is no stated limit to how many objects can be locked, but the effects dissipate if Sale moves far enough away. External force can still move a locked object slightly; accurate launching requires careful, light repeated taps.
jojo.stand.kraft_work.beaten_by: External force can move a locked object slightly, and moving far enough away from affected objects causes the effects to dissipate.
jojo.stand.kraft_work.summary: On touching an object, Kraft Work can remove its kinetic energy and lock it in place, including making it motionless relative to Sale or another object. Sale can also build energy in a locked object through repeated touches and release it to launch it.

jojo.stand.les_feuilles.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.les_feuilles.trigger: A path of enough leaves must be connected, and a person or object must touch it.
jojo.stand.les_feuilles.limit: The transport follows the leaf path; it can be interrupted by stepping on the path, making the transported object appear at the interceptor’s feet.
jojo.stand.les_feuilles.beaten_by: Stepping on the path while something is being transported interrupts the transport.
jojo.stand.les_feuilles.summary: Les Feuilles instantly transport anyone or anything that touches a connected path of fallen leaves from one end of the path to the other. Anyone who knows how can arrange and use the paths.

jojo.stand.limp_bizkit.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.limp_bizkit.trigger: Sports Maxx activates the ability; a nearby corpse or body part must be considered deceased. The wraiths attack nearby targets when commanded.
jojo.stand.limp_bizkit.limit: The wraiths can be killed by conventional attacks, and damage to a wraith also damages its original body. The text gives no specific range beyond 'nearby.'
jojo.stand.limp_bizkit.beaten_by: Conventional attacks can kill the wraiths; attacking one also damages its original body.
jojo.stand.limp_bizkit.summary: When Sports Maxx activates Limp Bizkit, nearby dead bodies or body parts produce permanently invisible, tangible zombie wraiths. He can command them to attack, and they have enhanced strength and can walk on walls; damage to a wraith is also inflicted on its original body.

jojo.stand.little_feet.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.little_feet.trigger: Little Feet must cut the person or object with its index finger to begin shrinking it. Little Feet can freely stop or reverse the effect; it can also change Formaggio’s and its own size.
jojo.stand.little_feet.limit: Shrinking a target is slow and cannot be accelerated, though it continues regardless of distance. A carried item stops shrinking if the target abandons it. Formaggio is physically limited and vulnerable while shrunken.
jojo.stand.little_feet.summary: After Little Feet cuts a person or object with its index finger, the target gradually shrinks, along with its clothes and carried items; a shrinking person’s Stand also becomes weaker. Little Feet can stop the shrinkage or instantly restore a shrunken target to normal size, and can instantly change Formaggio’s or its own size.

jojo.stand.love_deluxe.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.love_deluxe.trigger: Yukako uses the ability; when angered, she can grow her hair enough to cover and invade a house.
jojo.stand.love_deluxe.limit: It has a range of about 10 meters. Taking enough damage or overusing it turns Yukako’s hair white; destroyed hair strands do not damage her.
jojo.stand.love_deluxe.summary: Love Deluxe lets Yukako grow her hair and control it with strength and precision, using it to restrain or throw people and to reach hazards such as fire. She can also shoot strands and steer them independently.

jojo.stand.love_love_deluxe.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.love_love_deluxe.trigger: Karera uses the ability on another person's hair within 80 meters of herself.
jojo.stand.love_love_deluxe.summary: Love Love Deluxe lets Karera control and grow other people's hair, using it for practical effects such as making cushions or ropes and manipulating hairs to reveal information.

jojo.stand.lovers.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.lovers.trigger: For pain synchronization, Steely Dan must feel a physical sensation while Lovers is inside the victim’s brain. Other uses require Lovers to be in the brain and have brain cells to manipulate; growing a spore also requires DIO’s spore.
jojo.stand.lovers.limit: Lovers is extremely weak and vulnerable on its own. Its pain effect depends on sensations Steely Dan feels; the text gives no specific limit for the other uses.
jojo.stand.lovers.summary: Lovers enters a victim’s brain stem and manipulates their pain receptors: when Steely Dan feels physical sensation, it magnifies and inflicts the pain on the victim, including phantom pain. It can also reshape brain cells into disguises or harmful decoys, and use DIO’s spores to grow a brain-destroying organism.

jojo.stand.made_in_heaven.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.made_in_heaven.trigger: Pucci activates the Stand to begin accelerating time.
jojo.stand.made_in_heaven.limit: The acceleration affects the whole universe and progressively intensifies. Pucci still has human weaknesses and can tire or be harmed by hazardous environments; time acceleration also shortens the usable duration of time-stop abilities.
jojo.stand.made_in_heaven.beaten_by: Killing Pucci before the point when the original acceleration began resets the universe and undoes Made in Heaven’s effects.
jojo.stand.made_in_heaven.summary: Made in Heaven progressively accelerates time throughout the universe, while Pucci can keep pace and act with greatly increased speed. If acceleration reaches its endpoint, the universe resets into a new one where events follow the previous universe’s fate; killing Pucci before the original acceleration point causes another reset that undoes its effects.

jojo.stand.magician_s_red.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.magician_s_red.trigger: Avdol generates the flames; he can redirect or alter them with a thought. The heat radar responds to enemy presence.
jojo.stand.magician_s_red.limit: Water can extinguish the flames. Avdol can use his fire more fully in open spaces; the heat radar does not work on vampires.
jojo.stand.magician_s_red.beaten_by: Dousing the flames with water; vampires can evade the heat radar.
jojo.stand.magician_s_red.summary: Magician’s Red creates fire and lets Avdol shape, redirect, and control its intensity, using it to attack or bind targets. It can also sense heat sources with a flame-based radar, though non-Stand users cannot see the flames themselves.

jojo.stand.man_in_the_mirror.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.man_in_the_mirror.trigger: Illuso must use a reflective surface to enter or exit, or to drag a selected target into the mirror world.
jojo.stand.man_in_the_mirror.limit: Illuso can only enter or exit through a reflective surface. The Stand is physically weak in direct confrontations. Prisoners cannot see or hear the real world, and only Man in the Mirror can affect objects inside the mirror world.
jojo.stand.man_in_the_mirror.beaten_by: A disguised Stand may trick Illuso into allowing it into the mirror world. If Illuso dies, the mirror world is destroyed and its prisoners are freed.
jojo.stand.man_in_the_mirror.summary: Man in the Mirror lets Illuso enter a mirror world and pull chosen targets or parts of them into it through reflective surfaces. He can exclude a dragged-in Stand, leaving its User trapped without it; Illuso alone can affect things inside, and the world collapses if he dies.

jojo.stand.mandom.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.mandom.trigger: The hand on Ringo’s wristwatch must be turned; moving it by another means, such as a bullet, also triggers the rewind. The watch is described as a psychological switch and theoretically unnecessary.
jojo.stand.mandom.limit: The rewind always covers exactly six seconds. No other limitation is stated.
jojo.stand.mandom.beaten_by: Someone who is prepared for the rewind can use it to avoid attacks or set up a counterstrike.
jojo.stand.mandom.summary: Mandom rewinds time by exactly six seconds, restoring everything to its earlier state. People nearby who are affected retain memories of the rewound interval, which can disorient them or let them prepare for what follows.

jojo.stand.manhattan_transfer.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.manhattan_transfer.trigger: Air currents or an object moving through the air must be present for its sensing and reactions. To redirect a bullet, Johngalli must shoot at Manhattan Transfer.
jojo.stand.manhattan_transfer.limit: Its sensing depends on air currents, and layered gases can distort them and mislead Johngalli. Each redirected bullet has its trajectory changed once.
jojo.stand.manhattan_transfer.beaten_by: Distorting the air currents with different layers of gases can fool its sensing.
jojo.stand.manhattan_transfer.summary: Manhattan Transfer senses nearby air currents and relays information to Johngalli A., helping him locate and identify targets and react to incoming objects. It can also redirect a bullet fired at it once, letting Johngalli shoot around cover.

jojo.stand.manic_depression.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked

novel_sheet.name: Manic Depression
novel_sheet.source: Purple Smoke Distortion (Kadono), chapter-end Stand sheet

jojo.stand.manic_depression.trigger: For its effects on organisms, Manic Depression must pierce them with its thorns. The text does not specify what triggers the salt conversion.
jojo.stand.manic_depression.limit: Physical boosts last a couple of minutes, after which the body breaks down. The opiate made from salt lasts two weeks before reverting to salt.
jojo.stand.manic_depression.summary: Manic Depression’s thorns can raise an organism’s biological activity, causing effects such as an exploding heart or irregular digestion, or temporarily boosting physical attributes. It can also turn salt into an injectable opiate that later reverts to salt.

jojo.stand.marilyn_manson.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.marilyn_manson.trigger: The user and target must agree to a bet, and the target must lose; cheating or attempting to attack the user also counts as losing.
jojo.stand.marilyn_manson.limit: It only collects value equivalent to the wager and refuses to take things that do not rightfully belong to the target. The user can cancel the Stand, or be coerced into returning what it collected.
jojo.stand.marilyn_manson.beaten_by: Force the user to cancel the Stand or coerce them into returning the collected items.
jojo.stand.marilyn_manson.summary: After the user and a target agree to a bet, Marilyn Manson appears if the target loses and collects possessions of equivalent value that rightfully belong to them, potentially mutilating them to obtain valuable body parts. The Stand cannot be attacked while collecting, and cheating or trying to attack the user counts as a loss.

jojo.stand.memory_of_jet.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.memory_of_jet.trigger: Teruhiko activates the ability on a particular location or individual and continues to will its effect.
jojo.stand.memory_of_jet.limit: The effect is maintained on an annual basis while Teruhiko still wills it; Teruhiko is exempt from the exclusion.
jojo.stand.memory_of_jet.beaten_by: Teruhiko can guide someone to the targeted location, allowing that person access.
jojo.stand.memory_of_jet.summary: Memory of Jet isolates a chosen person or location from everyone else’s cognition, making the target and routes to it effectively inaccessible. Teruhiko can guide someone to the location, allowing them to reach it.

jojo.stand.metallica.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.metallica.trigger: Metallica is active and the iron is within 5–10 meters of Risotto; Risotto can direct the manipulation. Iron is naturally attracted by default.
jojo.stand.metallica.limit: Its effective area is a 5–10 meter circle around Risotto. Drawing iron from a target’s body reduces their hemoglobin and oxygen-carrying ability.
jojo.stand.metallica.summary: Metallica magnetically manipulates nearby iron, shaping iron from the environment or a person’s body into objects such as blades and needles. It can also use fine iron particles to camouflage Risotto or his blood against the background.

jojo.stand.milagro_man.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.milagro_man.trigger: A person is afflicted by touching the Stand’s money.
jojo.stand.milagro_man.limit: The money keeps returning or replenishing when the victim tries to spend or destroy it; the accumulating cash can eventually crush or suffocate them.
jojo.stand.milagro_man.beaten_by: Return the money to its previous owner, or have another person destroy it; the curse then transfers to the new victim.
jojo.stand.milagro_man.summary: Touching someone afflicts them with a curse that continually generates money around them, which they cannot permanently spend or destroy and that eventually buries or suffocates them. Returning the money to its previous owner or having someone else destroy it ends the victim’s affliction and transfers it to another person.

jojo.stand.moody_blues.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.moody_blues.trigger: Abbacchio uses Moody Blues to replay events involving a particular person or location.
