jojo.stand.moody_blues.limit: The farther back the event is, the longer Moody Blues must remain immobile to reach it. Some events, such as Clash teleporting through water, cannot be replayed. While rebroadcasting, Moody Blues cannot attack and is vulnerable; copied form lasts only a limited time.
jojo.stand.moody_blues.beaten_by: It is vulnerable while immobile and rebroadcasting; the text gives no specific counter.
jojo.stand.moody_blues.summary: Moody Blues reenacts past events involving a person or location, letting Abbacchio review the replay and pause or speed it up. During a replay it can temporarily take on a person's form and copy their recorded movements.

jojo.stand.mr_president.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.mr_president.trigger: A special key is placed in the depression on Coco Jumbo’s shell; approaching the hand on the key lets a person enter. Raising an arm lets an occupant exit.
jojo.stand.mr_president.limit: The room does not protect occupants from Stand powers that can affect them or breach its entrance.
jojo.stand.mr_president.beaten_by: Removing the key forcibly ejects the room’s occupants; Stand powers can affect occupants inside or breach the entrance.
jojo.stand.mr_president.summary: Mr.President provides access to a room inside Coco Jumbo: people can enter through the key and exit by raising an arm. Removing the key forcibly ejects anyone inside, and moving or tilting the turtle does not affect the room.

jojo.stand.nightbird_flying.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.nightbird_flying.trigger: The target must be tracked and within range.
jojo.stand.nightbird_flying.limit: The Stand does not fight directly; the effect weakens with distance from its main body.
jojo.stand.nightbird_flying.summary: Nightbird Flying tracks an individual soul and inflicts a fatal drug addiction that makes other memories incomprehensible, causes hallucinations, and impairs judgment. The effects grow stronger as the target gets closer to its main body.

jojo.stand.notorious_b_i_g.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.notorious_b_i_g.trigger: Carne's death activates it; it can infect those who touched his remains. It detects movement and targets the fastest-moving object within range.
jojo.stand.notorious_b_i_g.limit: It needs matter or energy to grow and recover. Its physical body can be damaged by ordinary means, though surviving pieces can regenerate if they reach energy. Its movement detection is limited to nearby motion.
jojo.stand.notorious_b_i_g.beaten_by: Use moving objects to distract it or keep it surrounded by competing motion; waves and currents can confuse it. Mundane damage can impair it, but may not stop surviving pieces from regenerating.
jojo.stand.notorious_b_i_g.summary: After Carne dies, Notorious B.I.G. activates and builds or regenerates its body by absorbing matter and energy. It automatically detects and pursues the fastest-moving nearby target, consuming flesh and energy as it grows.

jojo.stand.nut_king_call.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.nut_king_call.trigger: Plant nuts and bolts in a target; removing a nut from its bolt causes disassembly. To fasten objects together, they must be between a nut and a connecting bolt.
jojo.stand.nut_king_call.limit: The text gives no explicit range, cost, or general weakness; the effect on other targets appears to undo itself when they leave the user's range.
jojo.stand.nut_king_call.beaten_by: Moving out of the user's range appears to undo the separations, though the parts may reattach incorrectly.
jojo.stand.nut_king_call.summary: Nut King Call plants nuts and bolts in a target to make functional artificial joints; removing a nut from its bolt disassembles the joined object or body parts. It can also fasten objects together across a nut-and-bolt connection, and the user retains control and sensation in detached body parts.

jojo.stand.oasis.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.oasis.trigger: Secco must be wearing Oasis and touch the rock or ground to liquefy it. It hardens immediately if contact with Oasis is broken.
jojo.stand.oasis.limit: The liquefaction is described as having a range of at most 10 meters. Secco cannot see while moving underground and must rely on hearing. The text also says someone can be harmed by staying underground near Secco or by direct contact with him.
jojo.stand.oasis.summary: Oasis is a wearable Stand that enhances Secco’s strength and speed and lets him liquefy solid ground by touching it. He can travel through the softened ground, sink targets or structures, and use it to boost attacks or launch harmful projectiles; the ground hardens when it loses contact with Oasis.

jojo.stand.oh_lonesome_me.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.oh_lonesome_me.limit: Body segments can move only as far as the rope reaches.
jojo.stand.oh_lonesome_me.summary: Mountain Tim can split his or another person’s body into segments and slide them along a rope, which he can precisely control to move bodies or grab small objects. This allows him to launch himself, pass through small spaces, reduce blast damage, and absorb water through the rope.

jojo.stand.osiris.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.osiris.trigger: The opponent must agree to gamble the soul, lose the bet or game, and admit defeat in their heart. A person may wager someone else's soul, even if that person is absent and has not agreed.
jojo.stand.osiris.limit: Osiris's soul-taking requires an agreed soul wager; the text gives no range limit.
jojo.stand.osiris.beaten_by: Avoid losing or avoid admitting defeat in your heart; the text does not state another counter.
jojo.stand.osiris.summary: Osiris takes the soul of someone who loses a wager with D'Arby after they have agreed to stake that soul and inwardly accept defeat. It compresses captured souls into poker chips, which D'Arby can gamble, split into equivalent pieces, or release; souls he has collected die if D'Arby dies.

jojo.stand.ozon_baby.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.ozon_baby.trigger: Activation; the pressure variations become stronger near Poor Tom.
jojo.stand.ozon_baby.limit: Its area extends 100 meters from the Stand, and burying its Lego house in soil dampens the effect. Prolonged exposure can be lethal; closed spaces can also become dangerous as pressure rises inside them.
jojo.stand.ozon_baby.beaten_by: A closed room blocks the pressure effect and can let a victim recover, but remaining inside may become lethal. Burying the Lego house dampens the effect.
jojo.stand.ozon_baby.summary: Once activated, Ozon Baby automatically creates pressure anomalies within a 100-meter area, causing objects to collapse and exposed people to suffer worsening depressurization or crushing pressure. Closed rooms block the effect, though pressure inside them can still rise to lethal levels.

jojo.stand.paisley_park.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.paisley_park.trigger: It assists Yasuho or an ally with a problem; for the choice-based assistance, Yasuho must select an option before it times out.
jojo.stand.paisley_park.limit: It has low physical potency and is poor at direct confrontation. Choice-based assistance fails if Yasuho is too slow to choose.
jojo.stand.paisley_park.summary: Paisley Park autonomously guides Yasuho and her allies toward solutions, including by manipulating electronics and networks, offering timely choices, and providing useful items. It can also change its own shape.

jojo.stand.paper_moon_king.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.paper_moon_king.trigger: A Paper Moon King origami model must touch the target for the perception effect.
jojo.stand.paper_moon_king.limit: The text describes disorientation rather than combat ability. It does not specify a range or cost; origami can act without Tsurugi nearby.
jojo.stand.paper_moon_king.summary: When one of Paper Moon King’s origami models touches someone, it prevents them from distinguishing faces, objects, voices, or text, causing them to perceive them as alike or as a chosen confusion. Its origami can also move with qualities of the objects they depict, even when Tsurugi is absent.

jojo.stand.pearl_jam.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.pearl_jam.trigger: Tonio diagnoses the ailment, prepares and infuses a compatible dish, and the affected person eats it.
jojo.stand.pearl_jam.limit: The dish must match the ailment; more serious ailments require more expensive, higher-quality ingredients. The ability’s other limits are unknown.
jojo.stand.pearl_jam.beaten_by: An incompatible dish does not cure the eater.
jojo.stand.pearl_jam.summary: Tonio infuses Pearl Jam into a dish, and eating a dish compatible with an ailment triggers bodily changes that cure it. The dish’s ingredients determine whether it works and how quickly and strongly it heals.

jojo.stand.planet_waves.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.planet_waves.trigger: Planet Waves attracts meteoroids toward its user; they fall at intervals ranging from seconds to minutes.
jojo.stand.planet_waves.limit: The meteoroids usually are small, though larger ones can be attracted to break through sturdy obstacles. They disintegrate just before contacting the user, but an intervening object can absorb their fall and let them hit the user with full force.
jojo.stand.planet_waves.beaten_by: Place an object in a meteorite’s path so it absorbs the fall and allows the meteorite to hit the user.
jojo.stand.planet_waves.summary: Planet Waves draws meteoroids from space toward its user, where they can strike nearby people or objects with extreme speed and heat. Meteoroids disintegrate just before hitting the user, unless an object in their path absorbs their fall and redirects the impact onto the user.

jojo.stand.ptah.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.ptah.trigger: The user must read the history, silently or aloud, and call its historical cause; the thing must be written about in the book.
jojo.stand.ptah.limit: Only one thing can be materialized at a time, and it disappears if its page is damaged and made unreadable.
jojo.stand.ptah.beaten_by: Damage the page describing the manifestation until it is unreadable.
jojo.stand.ptah.summary: Ptah brings one thing described in a book’s history into reality after the user reads the history and calls its historical cause. The manifestation disappears if its page is damaged until unreadable.

jojo.stand.public_image_limited.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.public_image_limited.trigger: Rigatoni fires a bullet charged with Stand power; energy absorption requires the shot to hit its target.
jojo.stand.public_image_limited.limit: The Stand rapidly drains Rigatoni’s power, putting him at risk of dying each time he fires.
jojo.stand.public_image_limited.summary: The provided text describes Rigatoni’s Augmented Shot, not an ability called Public Image Limited. Augmented Shot spends Rigatoni’s Stand power to fire a faster, more powerful, precise bullet that dodges obstacles; if it hits, it absorbs Stand energy from the target equal to the amount charged into the shot.

jojo.stand.purple_haze.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.purple_haze.trigger: A bulb breaks, usually when Purple Haze punches something, or is fired from its hand; infection occurs when something enters the virus’s range.
jojo.stand.purple_haze.limit: The virus has short range, is weakened by light from any source, and can affect Fugo and his allies. An organism with the right antibodies can survive.
jojo.stand.purple_haze.beaten_by: Light weakens the virus; the right antibodies allow an organism to survive.
jojo.stand.purple_haze.summary: When a fist bulb breaks or is fired from Purple Haze’s hand, it releases a virus that infects anything entering its short range and rapidly decomposes flesh. The virus can affect allies and Fugo, but weakens in light; organisms with suitable antibodies can survive it.

jojo.stand.purple_haze_distortion.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.purple_haze_distortion.trigger: A capsule on its fist cracks to release the virus; the lethal effect occurs when the virus enters a body.
jojo.stand.purple_haze_distortion.limit: Light sterilizes the virus after several tens of seconds indoors. Releasing viruses from every bulb may cause them to consume and cancel one another.
jojo.stand.purple_haze_distortion.beaten_by: Light can neutralize it, and another virus or an infected organism can counteract it.
jojo.stand.purple_haze_distortion.summary: When a fist capsule cracks, Purple Haze Distortion releases a virus that can spread by touch or through the air. In a body, it rapidly destroys metabolic function; its stronger virus can also consume other viruses, potentially treating infections or countering another virus.

jojo.stand.rainy_day_dream_away.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked

novel_sheet.name: Rainy Day Dream Away
novel_sheet.source: Purple Smoke Distortion (Kadono), chapter-end Stand sheet

jojo.stand.rainy_day_dream_away.trigger: Someone has a thought within the Stand’s range, even momentarily.
jojo.stand.rainy_day_dream_away.limit: Vladimir chooses how long the effect lasts. Distance from him does not end it.
jojo.stand.rainy_day_dream_away.beaten_by: Temporarily overriding the repeating sensation with a similar but stronger sensation.
jojo.stand.rainy_day_dream_away.summary: Rainy Day Dream Away locks onto a sentiment from a thought someone has within its range and makes that person feel only that sentiment for as long as Vladimir chooses, potentially causing a delusion that seems to last a lifetime.

jojo.stand.ratt.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.ratt.trigger: A dart must hit its target.
jojo.stand.ratt.limit: Ratt can shoot up to 60 meters and fire in bursts. A hit melts a large part of the body; the injury is nearly impossible to heal, though Crazy Diamond can undo it.
jojo.stand.ratt.beaten_by: Avoiding or striking the nimble rat may prevent it from landing a hit.
jojo.stand.ratt.summary: Ratt fires barbed darts that melt anything they hit, including flesh and metal, turning it into organic material. Melted victims may remain alive if their head is intact, and fused flesh can be molded into shapes.

jojo.stand.red_hot_chili_pepper.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.red_hot_chili_pepper.trigger: It must absorb electricity to power up, and must be near electrical sources to maintain its stamina. To transport something, it must hold the object or person.
jojo.stand.red_hot_chili_pepper.limit: Its power-ups consume electricity; when its stored electricity runs out it weakens and begins to vanish. Falling into water disperses its electricity and disables it.
jojo.stand.red_hot_chili_pepper.beaten_by: Water can disperse its electricity and disable it; cutting off access to electrical sources can cause its stored power to run out.
jojo.stand.red_hot_chili_pepper.summary: Red Hot Chili Pepper absorbs electricity to increase its strength and speed and heal wounds. It can travel through electrical systems and turn objects it holds—and living people—into electricity to carry them through those systems.

jojo.stand.remote_romance.user:
Dixie Flatline (original)
People with access to video chat for the JoJo Exhibition
jojo.stand.remote_romance.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.remote_romance.trigger: A human must have access to the particular server.
jojo.stand.remote_romance.summary: The Stand possesses humans who can access a particular server, granting them the ability to project an alter ego to a remote location.

jojo.stand.rolling_stones.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.rolling_stones.trigger: It spots a chosen person whose death is fated to occur; touching the stone triggers that person's death.
jojo.stand.rolling_stones.limit: Scolippi cannot control or stop it. It can move through the ground and walls, and breaking it stops the chase but does not alter the prediction.
jojo.stand.rolling_stones.beaten_by: Breaking the stone stops it from chasing. People near it who are not its target are not fated to die from it.
jojo.stand.rolling_stones.summary: Rolling Stones automatically seeks a person fated to die, follows them, and displays a form showing how they will die. If that person touches the stone, they die peacefully; breaking the stone stops its pursuit but does not change the predicted fate.

jojo.stand.scary_monsters.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.scary_monsters.trigger: The user touches a victim, or a transformed dinosaur bites or scratches them. Diego can transform himself; fossilization affects beings transformed by the Stand.
jojo.stand.scary_monsters.limit: No range or number limit is stated for infections. If the user is severely injured, the power disappears and transformed dinosaurs revert. Diego’s movement-based vision makes him vulnerable to slow attacks.
jojo.stand.scary_monsters.beaten_by: Severely injuring the user ends the power and reverts transformed dinosaurs; slow attacks can exploit Diego’s movement-based vision.
jojo.stand.scary_monsters.summary: Scary Monsters infects living beings through contact, transforming them into dinosaurs that the user can control; Diego can also transform his own body and fossilize beings already transformed by the Stand.

jojo.stand.schott_key_no_1.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.schott_key_no_1.trigger: The elder touches the object with his left hand.
jojo.stand.schott_key_no_1.limit: The Stand has little offensive power on its own and the elder is vulnerable to conventional Stands.
jojo.stand.schott_key_no_1.beaten_by: Conventional Stands can attack the elder while he is defenseless.
jojo.stand.schott_key_no_1.summary: Schott Key No.1 transfers anything the elder touches with his left hand to a chosen materialization point near the rocky stub of his missing right hand. The transferred thing can reappear in a position or arrangement that slightly displaces it or helps bind an opponent.

jojo.stand.schott_key_no_2.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.schott_key_no_2.trigger: It constantly releases gas; a person must be exposed to it for the harmful effects to occur.
jojo.stand.schott_key_no_2.limit: The younger brother is not immune to the gas, and the Stand has no shown physical power. The gas’s full strength is not shown.
jojo.stand.schott_key_no_2.beaten_by: The text does not specify a counter.
jojo.stand.schott_key_no_2.summary: Schott Key No.2 automatically and constantly emits toxic gas that burns skin on contact, impairs breathing after brief exposure, and can kill with full exposure. The younger brother hides it inside a football because he is not immune to the gas.

jojo.stand.sethan.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.sethan.trigger: A target must stand in Alessi’s shadow; even brief contact can cause age regression.
jojo.stand.sethan.limit: Age regression happens rapidly and worsens with exposure. The text gives no range beyond Alessi’s shadow.
jojo.stand.sethan.summary: Sethan’s shadow copies Alessi’s actions and possessions, and anyone standing in it rapidly regresses in age, including their mind and Stand. If regression takes someone to before they acquired their Stand, they temporarily lose access to it.

jojo.stand.sex_pistols.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.sex_pistols.trigger: Mista must provide a gun and ammunition and fire a bullet for the Pistols to ride and redirect; splitting a bullet requires all six Pistols on it.
jojo.stand.sex_pistols.limit: Their effective range is limited by how far bullets can fly, and they are vulnerable while active. Without a gun and ammunition, they are generally useless for offense.
jojo.stand.sex_pistols.beaten_by: Attacking the Pistols while they are active can exploit their vulnerability.
jojo.stand.sex_pistols.summary: Sex Pistols ride bullets fired by Mista and kick them to redirect their paths; together, all six can split a bullet into multiple projectiles. They can also scout, reload, and act independently to help Mista or his allies.

jojo.stand.silver_chariot.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.silver_chariot.trigger: Polnareff directs Silver Chariot to attack, defend, shed its armor, or launch its sword.
jojo.stand.silver_chariot.limit: It usually stays near Polnareff and can move only several meters away. It cannot see what Polnareff cannot see. Armor slows it; shedding the armor makes it more vulnerable. It can materialize only one sword and must retrieve it after launching it.
jojo.stand.silver_chariot.beaten_by: Attack it from a blind spot Polnareff cannot see; attack while it has shed its armor; or keep its launched sword out of reach.
jojo.stand.silver_chariot.summary: Silver Chariot is a close-range, rapier-wielding Stand that attacks and defends with great speed and precision. It can shed its armor to move faster at the cost of protection, or launch its single sword as a piercing ranged attack that must be retrieved before it can attack with it again.

jojo.stand.sky_high.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.sky_high.trigger: Rikiel must concentrate and maintain his confidence to control the rods; they use body heat as sustenance.
jojo.stand.sky_high.limit: Control is more accurate at close range, though it can reach targets as far away as people in a helicopter. The rods’ effects can backfire on Rikiel.
jojo.stand.sky_high.beaten_by: If Rikiel panics, nearby rods are forced to stay still.
jojo.stand.sky_high.summary: Sky High lets Rikiel direct airborne rods to drain heat from chosen body parts, causing localized illness, impaired movement or senses, and potentially death. The rods can also numb Rikiel’s own nerves to reduce pain.

jojo.stand.soft_wet.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.soft_wet.trigger: The Stand generates and controls bubbles; stealing a property requires a bubble to contact its target. Stored contents can be released when the bubble bursts.
jojo.stand.soft_wet.limit: It is close-range, its strength cannot break rocks, and the duration and quantity of stolen properties are undefined. The ability cannot be applied to Josuke himself. Bubbles made from existing liquids last only briefly and lack the Stand-generated bubbles’ abilities.
jojo.stand.soft_wet.summary: Soft & Wet generates and steers floating bubbles that can lift or protect targets and, on contact, steal properties or small objects into a bubble for later release. Its enhanced close-range strikes can also deal physical damage; the hybrid bubbles can burst forcefully enough to cause damage.

jojo.stand.soft_machine.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.soft_machine.trigger: Soft Machine must stab the person or object with its rapier.
jojo.stand.soft_machine.limit: It needs a stab to deflate a target; its fighting ability is mediocre when exposed.
jojo.stand.soft_machine.summary: Soft Machine deflates a person or object it stabs with its rapier, leaving it limp and rubbery; people remain alive. Deflated targets can be stretched through small spaces, and an object can be used to conceal something beneath it.

jojo.stand.speed_king.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.speed_king.trigger: Jobin applies the heat to a point on an object or a person; the heat transfers when someone touches that point.
jojo.stand.speed_king.limit: It can affect objects only within 10 centimeters when storing heat. The affected object can travel farther away afterward while retaining the stored heat.
jojo.stand.speed_king.summary: Speed King stores intense heat at a localized point on an object or a person. Anyone who touches that point receives the heat, which can cause severe injury or death.

jojo.stand.spice_girl.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.spice_girl.trigger: Spice Girl must strike the object with her fists.
jojo.stand.spice_girl.limit: The softening can persist after contact ends, but the text gives no range or duration limit.
jojo.stand.spice_girl.summary: When Spice Girl strikes an object with her fists, she makes it rubber-like and elastic, so it resists crushing and puncturing and can absorb deformation. She can undo the softening; when the object returns to normal, stored energy or retained motion can produce a sudden backlash.

jojo.stand.stand_page_layout.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.stand_page_layout.summary: The text describes a wiki-page format for listing Stand abilities, not an ability that works as a game rule.

jojo.stand.star_platinum.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.star_platinum.trigger: Jotaro uses Star Platinum; its self-preservation can activate when he is in danger, even if he is unaware.
jojo.stand.star_platinum.limit: Its basic reach is only 2 meters from Jotaro. The text gives no other cost or weakness.
jojo.stand.star_platinum.summary: Star Platinum is a close-range Stand that uses extraordinary strength, speed, and precision to strike, manipulate, or intercept things. It can also perceive distant or fine details and sometimes protects Jotaro on its own.

jojo.stand.sticky_fingers.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.sticky_fingers.trigger: Its fist must touch a surface to create a zipper; Bucciarati can then open or close that zipper remotely.
jojo.stand.sticky_fingers.limit: The description gives no explicit range limit for remotely controlling zippers. Separation can cause serious harm or death, though its effects are inconsistent.
jojo.stand.sticky_fingers.summary: Sticky Fingers creates zippers on surfaces its fist touches, then Bucciarati can remotely open or close them to split, join, or open objects and use the resulting openings to move through, hide in, or store things inside them.

jojo.stand.stone_free.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.stone_free.trigger: Jolyne uses Stone Free to unravel some of her body into string, or gathers and meshes the string into its humanoid form.
jojo.stand.stone_free.limit: She can harmlessly unravel about 70% of her body. At that extent, the string reaches about 24 meters; humanoid form reduces range to around 2 meters. String can snap if strained, and cutting it harms her.
jojo.stand.stone_free.summary: Stone Free lets Jolyne unravel her body into controllable string, using it to sense vibrations, manipulate small objects, attack, restrain, defend, move, or stitch wounds. She can gather the string into a humanoid Stand to fight, but doing so sharply reduces its range.

jojo.stand.stray_cat.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.stray_cat.trigger: Stray Cat must be active and able to control the air near itself; its air control is stronger in sunlight.
jojo.stand.stray_cat.limit: The bubbles can be popped, and its power weakens in darkness; without light it becomes dormant.
jojo.stand.stray_cat.beaten_by: Popping the bubbles or keeping Stray Cat without light can counter or weaken it.
jojo.stand.stray_cat.summary: Stray Cat controls nearby air, forming invisible bubbles that it can fire, shape into restraints, use as shields, or burst remotely. Sunlight strengthens its air control; darkness weakens it, and total absence of light makes it dormant.

jojo.stand.strength.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.strength.trigger: Strength must bind itself to a small boat; Forever's control applies while it is bound to the object.
jojo.stand.strength.summary: Strength binds itself to a small boat and transforms it into a gigantic freighter. While bound to it, Forever can control the ship and its parts psychically, and move through its walls and floor as if they were liquid.

jojo.stand.sugar_mountain.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.sugar_mountain.trigger: The first trial activates when a person drops an object in a pond or spring near the tree. The second begins if they leave with the riches from the first trial.
jojo.stand.sugar_mountain.limit: The effect covers a large area around the tree. Riches from the first trial must all be disposed of through lawful exchanges before sunset; giving them away, discarding them, or losing them through theft or cheating does not count.
jojo.stand.sugar_mountain.beaten_by: Tell the truth in the first trial. To pass the second, lawfully trade, sell, or gamble away everything obtained, including money received in exchange.
jojo.stand.sugar_mountain.summary: Sugar Mountain’s Stand sets two trials around the tree: after someone drops an object in nearby water, the guardian tests whether they tell the truth; anyone who takes the riches must then lawfully use up everything gained before sunset. Breaking either trial brings punishment or absorption into the tree, while passing the tests lets the person keep the first trial’s riches.

jojo.stand.sun.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.sun.trigger: Sun emits light and heat; when threatened, it fires rays in all directions, or can aim them precisely.
jojo.stand.sun.limit: Its heat and light affect a large area and can be sustained for a long time, but the user is also at risk and must stay nearby and hide. Its rays can be deflected by Silver Chariot's sword.
jojo.stand.sun.beaten_by: Silver Chariot's sword can deflect its energy rays.
jojo.stand.sun.summary: Sun emits intense light and heat over a large area, raising temperatures to lethal levels, and can fire energy rays that pierce flesh and destroy objects. The user must stay nearby and take precautions because Sun does not protect him from its effects.

jojo.stand.super_fly.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.super_fly.trigger: The tower imprisons its first occupant. A second person entering activates the occupant swap condition; trying to escape can cause steel to cover and restrain the escapee. Damage to the tower triggers reflection.
jojo.stand.super_fly.limit: Only one occupant can remain trapped at a time. The tower is sustained by the energy of its sole prisoner. Reflected energy can rebound off the tower until it hits someone or escapes.
jojo.stand.super_fly.beaten_by: Another person can enter, allowing the first occupant to leave if they exit before the newcomer.
jojo.stand.super_fly.summary: Super Fly automatically traps one occupant in its tower; if another person enters, the first of them to leave is freed while the other remains trapped. It also reflects damage to the tower back toward its source and ejects foreign objects inserted inside.

jojo.stand.surface.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.surface.trigger: The mannequin must face the person to copy them. Forced synchronization works while Surface impersonates the person and stands in front of them.
jojo.stand.surface.limit: A screw on Surface’s forehead can reveal it as a copy; cut-off areas revert to wood. The forced movement requires Surface to remain in front of its victim.
jojo.stand.surface.summary: Surface copies a person’s appearance, voice, and mannerisms when its mannequin faces them. While impersonating that person and standing in front of them, it can force them to imitate its movements.

jojo.stand.survivor.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.survivor.trigger: It travels across wet surfaces; people under its influence are affected.
jojo.stand.survivor.limit: It is uncontrollable and mainly causes mayhem. Guccio is unaffected by it.
jojo.stand.survivor.summary: Survivor automatically travels across wet surfaces and stimulates people it affects, greatly amplifying their aggression until they fight recklessly. Those affected also ignore pain and fear and can see opponents’ muscular strong and weak points.

jojo.stand.talking_head.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.talking_head.trigger: Talking Head must latch onto the victim’s tongue; tongue control is used while affecting a victim.
jojo.stand.talking_head.limit: The Stand is fragile and has negligible speed and power. Victims know they are being forced to lie and may appear distressed; whether they can be made to speak or must remain silent depends on their resilience.
jojo.stand.talking_head.summary: After latching onto a victim’s tongue, Talking Head can force them to express falsehoods whenever they speak, write, or gesture, and Tiziano can toggle this effect or make them speak or stay silent. It can also control and elongate the victim’s tongue to manipulate nearby objects.

jojo.stand.tatoo_you.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.tatoo_you.trigger: An Eleven Men member uses the tattoo on his back to enter or emerge from another member.
jojo.stand.tatoo_you.limit: The ability is shared among the Eleven Men and uses their back tattoos; no other range or cost is stated.
jojo.stand.tatoo_you.summary: The Eleven Men can enter one another through the tattoos on their backs, share the same space, and emerge through a tattoo at will. Men hidden inside a companion are unharmed if that companion dies and can reposition the body to attack.

jojo.stand.tenore_sax.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.tenore_sax.trigger: The text gives no specific trigger beyond Tenore Sax generating the illusions.
jojo.stand.tenore_sax.limit: It does not create olfactory illusions; Iggy's nose could detect Kenny G.'s presence.
jojo.stand.tenore_sax.beaten_by: Defeating Kenny G. dispels the illusions.
jojo.stand.tenore_sax.summary: Tenore Sax creates convincing illusions that alter how an area looks and feels, making spaces seem vast or labyrinthine. The illusions end when Kenny G. is defeated.

jojo.stand.the_book.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.the_book.trigger: The target must be within 2 meters and able to see, read, and understand the text; reading a page activates the memory implantation.
jojo.stand.the_book.limit: The Book can maintain itself only within 30 meters of Takuma, and consulting older memories takes time because pages must be turned from the most recent onward. The implanted incidents cannot be fatal by themselves, and Takuma can be affected if he reads the pages accidentally.
jojo.stand.the_book.beaten_by: Keep the target from reading the text—for example, by being outside the 2-meter range, closing their eyes, being unable to see, or not understanding Japanese.
jojo.stand.the_book.summary: The Book records Takuma’s memories and can implant them in anyone who reads its pages, making the reader experience those events as their own; the imposed memories can cause physical effects or help train a skill through repeated experience.

jojo.stand.the_cure.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.the_cure.trigger: A living organism has wounds, an illness, or emotional distress for The Cure to absorb.
jojo.stand.the_cure.limit: Absorbed pain accumulates in the Stand. If it exceeds an unspecified limit, The Cure grows extremely large and goes berserk; damage then makes it stronger.
jojo.stand.the_cure.beaten_by: The absorbed pain normally diverges over time.
jojo.stand.the_cure.summary: The Cure heals a living organism’s wounds, illnesses, and emotional distress by absorbing them. The absorbed pain builds up in the Stand, making it grow; if it exceeds a limit, the Stand becomes berserk and grows stronger when damaged, though the pain normally fades over time.

jojo.stand.the_fool.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.the_fool.trigger: Iggy manipulates the sand to make it take a desired form or change its properties.
jojo.stand.the_fool.summary: The Fool is a sand Stand that Iggy can manipulate, changing it into shapes such as people, useful objects, or a protective dome. Its sand can resist soaking and change density to trap objects, and attacks on the sand do not harm Iggy.

jojo.stand.the_grateful_dead.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.the_grateful_dead.trigger: The power is activated to affect a large area, or The Grateful Dead grabs a target for faster aging.
jojo.stand.the_grateful_dead.limit: A target’s body heat affects the rate: warmer bodies age faster. The area mode can affect allies as well as enemies, and Prosciutto can toggle the effect on himself.
jojo.stand.the_grateful_dead.beaten_by: Sufficient cold, such as ingesting ice, immediately counters and reverses the effect; insufficient cold has no effect.
jojo.stand.the_grateful_dead.summary: The Grateful Dead rapidly ages organisms physically and mentally, either indiscriminately across a large area or faster by grabbing a target. The effect also weakens enemy Stands, and Prosciutto can choose whether it affects him.

jojo.stand.the_hand.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.the_hand.trigger: The Hand’s right palm must touch the target during a swiping motion, at Okuyasu’s will.
jojo.stand.the_hand.limit: The effect is concentrated in the palm and has short reach; stitching gaps has limits. Okuyasu’s slow reactions also reduce its effectiveness.
jojo.stand.the_hand.beaten_by: Grab or block The Hand’s arm before it can swipe, or evade the swipe with sufficient speed.
jojo.stand.the_hand.summary: When The Hand’s right palm sweeps across something, it erases the touched matter or space. Adjacent space and objects usually close the gap, which can pull a target closer or bring Okuyasu toward it.

jojo.stand.the_lock.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.the_lock.trigger: Tamami makes someone feel guilty, including over a perceived or false wrongdoing.
jojo.stand.the_lock.limit: It persists indefinitely, even when Tamami is away. The text gives no range or cost.
jojo.stand.the_lock.beaten_by: The victim can stop feeling guilty or resolve the source of the guilt; Tamami can also willingly cancel The Lock.
jojo.stand.the_lock.summary: When Tamami makes someone feel guilty, The Lock appears in their chest and automatically amplifies their guilt, growing heavier as it accumulates. It remains until the guilt’s source is resolved, Tamami cancels it, or the victim dies by suicide.

jojo.stand.the_world.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.the_world.trigger: DIO must consciously activate the time stop; a surprise attack can prevent him from doing so.
jojo.stand.the_world.limit: In the described weakened state, stopped time lasts up to five seconds initially and grows to a maximum of nine seconds. The World’s effective manifestation range is approximately 10 meters.
jojo.stand.the_world.beaten_by: A surprise attack can prevent activation. People with the same time-stopping power can act during stopped time.
jojo.stand.the_world.summary: The World lets DIO consciously stop time, during which he and others with the same power can act. DIO can move himself and objects he touches, and actions he takes can continue to have force when time resumes.

jojo.stand.the_world_diego_brando.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.the_world_diego_brando.limit: The time stop lasts approximately five seconds at most; the text gives no other cost or range for this ability.
jojo.stand.the_world_diego_brando.summary: THE WORLD stops time for up to about five seconds, during which only Diego and the Stand can act. Thrown objects eventually stop in midair and resume moving at their previous velocity when time restarts.

jojo.stand.the_world_over_heaven.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.the_world_over_heaven.trigger: To overwrite reality, The World Over Heaven must punch the target. DIO can also stop time; no further trigger is specified.
jojo.stand.the_world_over_heaven.limit: Reality overwrite requires a punch. No limit is stated for time stop.
jojo.stand.the_world_over_heaven.summary: The World Over Heaven can overwrite a target’s reality, including its existence, and can stop time so DIO can act while others cannot. Reality overwrite is initiated by the Stand’s fists; the text gives no stated limit for time stop.

jojo.stand.ticket_to_ride.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.ticket_to_ride.trigger: The tears must touch someone or something to make it vulnerable to Divine Protection; the protection seems to work only while Lucy can move and against targets she has touched with the Tear Cutter.
jojo.stand.ticket_to_ride.limit: The tear blades immediately decompose on contact and are mainly useful for marking a target. The text gives no other explicit cost or range.
jojo.stand.ticket_to_ride.summary: Ticket to Ride lets Lucy pull tear streaks that act briefly as knives and, after they touch a target, makes unlikely coincidences protect her or steer that target toward an outcome she wants. Its protection can also restore a destroyed object through a chain of coincidences.

jojo.stand.tohth.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.tohth.trigger: Time passes while someone reads the book; it fills in predictions relevant to that reader.
jojo.stand.tohth.limit: It predicts only up to several minutes ahead and shows key events with incomplete details and potentially misleading narration. It is not suited for direct combat.
jojo.stand.tohth.summary: Tohth gradually fills its blank pages with predictions of events relevant to whoever reads it, usually several minutes ahead. The predictions are guaranteed to come true, and if someone’s actions would prevent one, events may force it to happen another way, potentially harming that person.

jojo.stand.tomb_of_the_boom.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.tomb_of_the_boom.trigger: A living being must touch a family member, including through a few drops of blood, to be magnetized.
jojo.stand.tomb_of_the_boom.limit: The magnetism weakens when victims are far from the family and becomes more lethal when affected people are close together; the text gives no other cost or range.
jojo.stand.tomb_of_the_boom.summary: The family can magnetize living beings by touching them, causing nearby metal and other affected people to be pulled toward them; the force can drive metal into bodies or tear victims apart. Individual members also manipulate metal or iron sand for attacks and restraint.

jojo.stand.tower_of_gray.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.tower_of_gray.trigger: The Stand uses its stinger to attack; its exceptional evasion applies against attacks it can see coming.
jojo.stand.tower_of_gray.limit: It is small and fragile, and cannot dodge attacks it does not see coming.
jojo.stand.tower_of_gray.beaten_by: A sneak attack or other attack it does not see coming.
jojo.stand.tower_of_gray.summary: Tower of Gray is a fast, nimble flying Stand that attacks with an extendable stinger capable of piercing or tearing flesh. Its speed lets it evade many attacks, but it can be caught by something it does not see coming.

jojo.stand.tubular_bells.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.tubular_bells.trigger: Mike O. must blow into a metallic object to inflate and shape it. A balloon can attack automatically when it detects the scent registered to it.
jojo.stand.tubular_bells.limit: Requires a metal object; the balloons follow only simple instructions and can be lured into attacking someone unrelated. Tubular Bells is poor at defending its user.
jojo.stand.tubular_bells.beaten_by: Hot Pants' Cream Starter is stated to defeat Mike O.
jojo.stand.tubular_bells.summary: By blowing into a metal object, Mike O. inflates and reshapes it into a floating, elastic balloon animal that can follow simple commands. The animals can act autonomously on a registered scent, then burrow into a target and revert to their original metal form, injuring them.

jojo.stand.tusk.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.tusk.trigger: Johnny spins his nails with the Spin and shoots them; the stronger tracking holes require Golden Rectangle rotation. To use the ACT3 wormhole, he must shoot himself with an aureal-rotation nail.
jojo.stand.tusk.limit: ACT1 nail shots reach up to 10 meters and cannot cut metal. Shot nails take time to regrow; Golden Rectangle nails take several minutes, limiting ammunition. Tracking holes shrink and disappear after a while, and the wormhole is limited by how long its holes persist.
jojo.stand.tusk.beaten_by: No specific counter is stated; metal resists ACT1 nail cuts.
jojo.stand.tusk.summary: Johnny spins and shoots his nails as cutting projectiles; with Golden Rectangle rotation, the shots drill harder and leave holes that can chase a target and strike wherever they touch. In ACT3, Johnny can shoot himself into one of these holes to reposition through a wormhole, while anything else entering it is cut.

jojo.stand.under_world.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.under_world.trigger: Under World must be able to dig into the ground in Orlando, Florida.
jojo.stand.under_world.limit: It cannot summon memories if it cannot dig. Those caught in a replay are bound to the event as it originally happened.
jojo.stand.under_world.beaten_by: Find a loophole or safe area in the replay; knowing the event well helps. Preventing Under World from digging also stops it from summoning memories.
jojo.stand.under_world.summary: By digging into Orlando soil, Under World brings past events and people back as earth-made memories. Anyone caught in a replay must experience the event and cannot change its course, though they can escape by exploiting a loophole within it.

jojo.stand.vitamin_c.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.vitamin_c.trigger: A living organism, including a Stand, touches one of Vitamin C’s fingerprints.
jojo.stand.vitamin_c.limit: Its range is very short, apparently limited to a single enclosed area. The fingerprints may be noticed, and Vitamin C lacks exceptional physical abilities.
jojo.stand.vitamin_c.beaten_by: Leaving Vitamin C’s range immediately disperses the softening effects; ranged attacks can exploit its short range.
jojo.stand.vitamin_c.summary: Vitamin C softens living tissue into an elastic, liquid-like state on contact with its faint fingerprints, eventually leaving victims unable to move or attack. Damo can vary how quickly the softening takes effect.

jojo.stand.voodoo_child.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked

novel_sheet.name: Voodoo Child
novel_sheet.source: Purple Smoke Distortion (Kadono), chapter-end Stand sheet

jojo.stand.voodoo_child.trigger: Voodoo Child punches; the lips repeat what someone said near the punched location. Punching someone causes lips on the target to reveal their deepest secret.
jojo.stand.voodoo_child.limit: The text gives no range beyond speech near the punched location. The emotional damage may be fatal depending on the target’s mental strength.
jojo.stand.voodoo_child.summary: When Voodoo Child punches, lips appear and repeat speech heard near the punched location, resembling the speaker’s mouth. If it punches someone, lips on that target reveal and repeat their deepest secret, causing emotional damage that can be fatal depending on their mental strength.

jojo.stand.walking_heart.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.walking_heart.trigger: Hato uses the ability; the text gives no more specific trigger.
jojo.stand.walking_heart.limit: The spikes extend up to 4 meters. It is unknown whether Walking Heart can extend other objects.
jojo.stand.walking_heart.summary: Walking Heart rapidly hardens Hato’s heels—or the heels of her shoes—and extends them into spikes that can pierce surfaces and bodies, letting her attack or climb walls.

jojo.stand.weather_report.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.weather_report.trigger: Weather Report uses its Stand to manipulate the atmosphere; the text gives no more specific trigger.
jojo.stand.weather_report.limit: Its range and scale vary: it can create micro-climates and make rain as far as 30 km away. No cost is stated.
jojo.stand.weather_report.summary: Weather Report manipulates the surrounding atmosphere to create and control weather and air effects, such as wind, rain, lightning, fog, and localized changes in air resistance or gas concentration. It can use these effects to move or harm targets, detect movement through air currents, and provide protection or cushioning.

jojo.stand.wheel_of_fortune.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.wheel_of_fortune.trigger: ZZ uses the car as the Stand’s catalyst; its strength and monstrous appearance increase with his aggression, and it reverts when he begs for his life.
jojo.stand.wheel_of_fortune.limit: Its transformation depends on the car, and its power is linked to ZZ’s confidence.
jojo.stand.wheel_of_fortune.summary: Wheel of Fortune transforms ZZ’s car, enhancing it and reshaping or repairing it for different uses; its power grows with ZZ’s aggression and fades when he begs for his life. It can also fire gasoline and hijack nearby car radios.

jojo.stand.white_album.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.white_album.trigger: Ghiaccio touches an object to freeze it; he wears White Album's armor. White Album Gently Weeps freezes surrounding air to create reflective sheets.
jojo.stand.white_album.limit: Touch is required to freeze objects. Gently Weeps drains Ghiaccio's stamina and does not fully cover his body. The armor's neck air hole is vulnerable, and massive or sharp objects can pierce it.
jojo.stand.white_album.beaten_by: Target the exposed neck opening or guide bullets through gaps in the frozen-air sheets. A sufficiently massive or sharp object can pierce the armor.
jojo.stand.white_album.summary: White Album lowers the temperature of anything Ghiaccio touches, freezing it and slowing or stopping its movement; it can also shape ice, encase him in protective armor, and freeze air into sheets that reflect bullets. The armor boosts his physical abilities, but its neck opening is vulnerable, and the bullet-reflecting technique drains stamina and leaves gaps.

jojo.stand.whitesnake.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.whitesnake.trigger: Disc extraction requires Whitesnake to touch the victim and take time to physically extract the disc; inserted discs must be placed into a person's head.
jojo.stand.whitesnake.limit: Extraction is slow, and partial extraction is ineffective. Acid takes significant time to melt a target; dream victims may wake by noticing discrepancies with reality.
jojo.stand.whitesnake.beaten_by: A person in the acid-induced dream can wake by recognizing discrepancies between the dream and established reality; inserted discs can sometimes be forcibly ejected.
jojo.stand.whitesnake.summary: Whitesnake can touch a person and, over time, extract their memories, Stand, senses, or other contents as tangible discs, then insert discs into a person to restore or grant those contents or impose instructions. It can also slowly dissolve targets with acid and create illusions.

jojo.stand.wired.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.wired.trigger: The user sends the hooks through a pan of water and places an object on its surface; the hooks can emerge from another object of the same kind.
jojo.stand.wired.limit: The water surface is small and gives only a limited view. The hooks can pull very heavy targets, but the text gives no specific maximum range.
jojo.stand.wired.beaten_by: Others can use the objects as portals too, and can shoot through them to hit the user.
jojo.stand.wired.summary: Wired sends its hooks through a small water surface and matching objects, letting them emerge elsewhere to grab and pull people or other things. The objects also let anything pass through them, in either direction.

jojo.stand.yellow_temperance.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.yellow_temperance.trigger: Absorbing organic matter requires physical contact; a deposited piece spreads across the person it has touched. The text gives no further trigger for changing Rubber Soul’s appearance or acting as armor.
jojo.stand.yellow_temperance.limit: Its growth depends on consuming organic matter. Its protection does not overcome Rubber Soul’s human vulnerabilities, and the Stand’s physical invulnerability depends on Rubber Soul remaining alive.
jojo.stand.yellow_temperance.beaten_by: Exploit Rubber Soul’s human vulnerabilities, including his need for oxygen; killing him also removes the basis for the Stand’s physical invulnerability.
jojo.stand.yellow_temperance.summary: Yellow Temperance absorbs organic matter it touches, growing larger and stronger; a piece placed on someone spreads over them and can assimilate and kill them. It can also alter Rubber Soul’s appearance and absorb physical impacts as armor, but does not protect him from human frailties such as needing oxygen.

jojo.stand.yo_yo_ma.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.stand.yo_yo_ma.trigger: D an G sends it to pursue a general goal, such as killing Jolyne or retrieving the Green Baby; it can act independently while doing so. Its acid works when saliva exposes a victim, including via spray, contaminated water, or biting mosquitoes.
jojo.stand.yo_yo_ma.limit: It has high range and resilience; the text gives no specific range limit or cost. The acid’s effects can take time to become noticeable.
jojo.stand.yo_yo_ma.beaten_by: Anasui disabled it, though it was not killed; the user was beaten instead.
jojo.stand.yo_yo_ma.summary: Yo-Yo Ma is an autonomous, highly resilient Stand that follows broad goals and independently attacks obstacles. It secretes acid saliva that can go unnoticed until exposed victims’ flesh begins to dissolve.

jojo.hamon.forced_ripple_breathing.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.forced_ripple_breathing.trigger: The user must perform the precise gut punch.
jojo.hamon.forced_ripple_breathing.limit: It is difficult to perform and can fail even for experienced Ripple Masters; the target’s breath loss and agony are momentary.
jojo.hamon.forced_ripple_breathing.summary: The user delivers a precise gut punch with the little finger raised, briefly making the target lose their breath and suffer agony while enabling them to produce Ripple. The technique can also help heal ordinary wounds faster and gauge a neophyte’s Ripple potential.

jojo.hamon.zoom_punch.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.zoom_punch.trigger: The user performs the Ripple breathing technique while launching a fist strike.
jojo.hamon.zoom_punch.limit: The extended reach comes from dislocating and stretching the joints; Ripple dulls the pain but does not prevent the injury.
jojo.hamon.zoom_punch.summary: The user extends a striking arm by dislocating and stretching its joints, using Ripple to dull the resulting pain, then hits the opponent at increased reach.

jojo.hamon.ripple_cutter.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.ripple_cutter.trigger: The user spits globs of liquid and combines them with Ripple.
jojo.hamon.ripple_cutter.summary: The user spits liquid globs infused with Ripple, making them sharp and dense enough to cut solid objects or deflect other projectiles.

jojo.hamon.send_wave_kick.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.send_wave_kick.trigger: The Ripple-infused knee strike must connect, and its energy must enter a vampire’s or zombie’s bloodstream.
jojo.hamon.send_wave_kick.summary: The user delivers a knee strike infused with Ripple energy. If the energy enters a vampire’s or zombie’s bloodstream, it tears the target apart.

jojo.hamon.ripple_detector.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.ripple_detector.trigger: A contained liquid must be imbued with Ripple, and someone must hold it.
jojo.hamon.ripple_detector.limit: The text gives no further range or cost.
jojo.hamon.ripple_detector.summary: The user imbues a contained liquid with Ripple; its effect lets the liquid’s holder sense the surroundings and detect others, even through walls.

jojo.hamon.send_ripple_overdrive.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.send_ripple_overdrive.trigger: The user charges the Ripple through their arm and releases it into a solid object.
jojo.hamon.send_ripple_overdrive.limit: The Ripple travels through a solid object; no range or other cost is stated.
jojo.hamon.send_ripple_overdrive.summary: The user charges a Ripple through their arm and releases it into a solid object, sending the wave through the object to strike targets on the other side. Those hit are hurled away in a spiral; against Undead, the Ripple enters the bloodstream and destroys them internally.

jojo.hamon.scarlet_overdrive.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.scarlet_overdrive.trigger: The user charges Ripple into one hand and transfers the resulting flame to a body part; something must touch that part to risk catching fire.
jojo.hamon.scarlet_overdrive.limit: Contact only has a chance of causing ignition. No other cost, range, or weakness is stated.
jojo.hamon.scarlet_overdrive.summary: The user charges Ripple into one hand to create a flame, then transfers it to another body part. Anything that touches the flaming body part has a chance of catching fire.

jojo.hamon.turquoise_blue_overdrive.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.turquoise_blue_overdrive.trigger: The user uses the Ripple underwater.
jojo.hamon.turquoise_blue_overdrive.limit: The text gives no specific cost or weakness.
jojo.hamon.turquoise_blue_overdrive.summary: The Ripple user releases powerful underwater tempests that blast enemies away and propel surrounding water outward, potentially lowering a lake to waist depth.

jojo.hamon.overdrive_barrage.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.overdrive_barrage.trigger: The user must jab fast enough consecutively.
jojo.hamon.overdrive_barrage.summary: A Ripple user who jabs rapidly in succession can release multiple Overdrives at once.

jojo.hamon.metal_silver_overdrive.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.metal_silver_overdrive.trigger: A metal path must connect the Ripple to its target.
jojo.hamon.metal_silver_overdrive.limit: Its special transfer works through metal; no range or cost is stated.
jojo.hamon.metal_silver_overdrive.summary: It performs a Sendo Ripple Overdrive and lets the Ripple pass through metal to reach its target.

jojo.hamon.life_magnetism_overdrive.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.life_magnetism_overdrive.trigger: Another Ripple user helps to draw and join nearby leaves; plant restoration can occur through contact with Ripple.
jojo.hamon.life_magnetism_overdrive.limit: Leaf gathering is limited to the immediate area. The technique can be applied to most plants.
jojo.hamon.life_magnetism_overdrive.summary: With help from another Ripple user, it draws nearby leaves together and magnetizes them into a large leaf that can serve as a hang glider. Ripple contact can also passively restore wilted plants.

jojo.hamon.sunlight_yellow_overdrive.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.sunlight_yellow_overdrive.trigger: The user performs the Ripple-infused attack.
jojo.hamon.sunlight_yellow_overdrive.limit: The text gives no cost or range.
jojo.hamon.sunlight_yellow_overdrive.summary: The user delivers a powerful Ripple-infused strike, either as one attack or a rapid series of punches. It can completely obliterate the Undead.

jojo.hamon.tornado_overdrive.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.tornado_overdrive.trigger: The user leaps into the air and points their legs toward an opponent.
jojo.hamon.tornado_overdrive.summary: The user channels Ripple into their lower body and dives at an opponent in a spinning, drill-like attack.

jojo.hamon.deep_pass_overdrive.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.deep_pass_overdrive.trigger: A Ripple user must be right before death, and the recipient must also be a Ripple user.
jojo.hamon.deep_pass_overdrive.limit: The transfer uses all of the performer's life energy.
jojo.hamon.deep_pass_overdrive.summary: Right before death, a Ripple user can transfer all of their life energy to another Ripple user. The recipient gains the performer's power, greatly increasing their strength, agility, and Ripple techniques, while the performer rapidly appears aged.

jojo.hamon.slowing_aging_process.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.slowing_aging_process.trigger: The user continually exercises the Ripple through Ripple breathing.
jojo.hamon.slowing_aging_process.summary: Regular Ripple breathing imbues the user with lifeforce and slows their aging, making them look younger than their actual age without stopping aging entirely.

jojo.hamon.ripple_hair_attack.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.ripple_hair_attack.trigger: The user must infuse the hair strands with Ripple.
jojo.hamon.ripple_hair_attack.limit: It blocks incoming projectiles; no further range or cost is specified.
jojo.hamon.ripple_hair_attack.summary: The user infuses hair strands with Ripple, hardening them so they can block incoming projectiles.

jojo.hamon.overdrive.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.overdrive.summary: Overdrive sends a large pulse of Ripple through an object.

jojo.hamon.ripple_hypnosis.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.ripple_hypnosis.trigger: The user applies the Ripple through a kiss or by touching the target’s head; the text does not specify further conditions.
jojo.hamon.ripple_hypnosis.summary: A Ripple user can hypnotize someone through a kiss or by touching their head, causing them to obey the user’s demands and become stronger through the Ripple. A Ripple Master can also use the technique to extract forgotten memories.

jojo.hamon.bubble_launcher.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.bubble_launcher.trigger: The user fires bubbles from their gloves.
jojo.hamon.bubble_launcher.limit: The text gives no range, cost, or other weakness.
jojo.hamon.bubble_launcher.summary: The user launches a barrage of Ripple-coated bubbles from their gloves. The coating makes the bubbles denser, so they strike with enough impact to blow away a grown man.

jojo.hamon.bubble_barrier.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.bubble_barrier.trigger: The Ripple user uses the technique.
jojo.hamon.bubble_barrier.limit: It creates a single gigantic bubble rather than a barrage of bubbles.
jojo.hamon.bubble_barrier.summary: The Ripple user conjures one gigantic bubble that absorbs and traps a target, rather than firing multiple bubbles in a barrage.

jojo.hamon.repel.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.repel.trigger: The user applies the Ripple as a repellent or shield.
jojo.hamon.repel.summary: A Ripple user can repel or deflect things with the Ripple, using it as a shield; it can also force an entity out of someone’s body.

jojo.hamon.bubble_cutter.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.bubble_cutter.limit: The text gives no cost or range.
jojo.hamon.bubble_cutter.summary: The user fires fast, highly maneuverable bubbles that spin like bladed saucers and slice what they hit; the Ripple keeps them intact while they spin.

jojo.hamon.bubble_cutter_gliding.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.bubble_cutter_gliding.trigger: The user launches the bubbles and aims them at an opponent.
jojo.hamon.bubble_cutter_gliding.limit: The attack uses fewer bubbles than the regular Bubble Cutter.
jojo.hamon.bubble_cutter_gliding.summary: The user launches a small number of bubbles that home toward an opponent and can curve around obstacles, trading the usual attack’s quantity for a better chance to hit.

jojo.hamon.bubble_lenses.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.bubble_lenses.trigger: The user launches the bubbles, and a light source passes through them.
jojo.hamon.bubble_lenses.limit: The bubbles become stationary after launch; no range or cost is stated.
jojo.hamon.bubble_lenses.beaten_by: Prevent light from passing through the bubbles.
jojo.hamon.bubble_lenses.summary: The user creates Ripple-infused bubbles that stay in place and refract and focus light into beams. When light passes through them, the bubbles trigger one another and send multiple beams toward a target.

jojo.hamon.rebuff_overdrive.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.rebuff_overdrive.trigger: The user charges Ripple into their elbows and strikes.
jojo.hamon.rebuff_overdrive.summary: The user channels Ripple into their elbows and delivers a powerful strike.

jojo.hamon.snake_muffler.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.snake_muffler.trigger: The user must have the scarf made from Sathiphorosia Scaraba yarn and send Ripple through it.
jojo.hamon.snake_muffler.limit: The technique depends on the special scarf; the text says it can be used only occasionally.
jojo.hamon.snake_muffler.summary: The user channels Ripple through a special scarf, which becomes rigid enough to support them upside down and can sense nearby life signs and the direction of incoming attacks, even out of sight.

jojo.hamon.ripple_overdrive.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.ripple_overdrive.trigger: The user channels Ripple into their arm and performs a chop that hits a target.
jojo.hamon.ripple_overdrive.summary: The user channels Ripple into an arm and delivers a powerful chop. The Ripple blast transfers through the point struck, advances, and eventually explodes.

jojo.hamon.ripple_beat.tag_basis: Luna over the wiki ability text; unchecked
jojo.hamon.ripple_beat.trigger: The user strikes an opponent with their charged hand.
jojo.hamon.ripple_beat.summary: The user charges their hand with Ripple and delivers a chopping strike to an opponent.
